title: Info3R: Information-Adaptive Test-Time Training for 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Transformer-based models have recently achieved strong performance on 3D reconstruction from images, and recent works extend them to process video streams in an online manner for real-world deployment. However, existing methods overlook two key signals when handling long image streams: the importance of each incoming frame and the information saturation of the model's internal state. In this paper, we propose Info3R, a novel information-adaptive test-time training method for the online 3D reconstruction. We introduce an information-aware state update that modulates the state update strength based on the redundancy and informativeness of each incoming frame. To restore the state's plasticity -- its capacity to incorporate new observations -- we propose a dynamic state reset, triggered by the cumulative magnitude of state updates and the model's prediction confidence and accompanied by an anchor-to-world alignment. Our method achieves consistent improvements on camera pose estimation, video depth estimation, and 3D reconstruction, while substantially mitigating the performance degradation in the long sequence evaluation. Notably, on KITTI Odometry, our method achieves on average 1.68x lower ATE than LongStream, demonstrating its robustness on extended outdoor sequences.
tldr: Info3R通过信息自适应测试时训练，依据帧信息量与状态饱和动态更新和重置状态，提升在线3D重建的长序列性能。
motivation: 现有在线3D重建方法处理长图像流时，忽略了每个新帧的重要性以及模型内部状态的信息饱和问题，导致长序列中性能明显退化。
method: 提出信息感知状态更新，根据每帧的冗余度与信息量调节状态更新强度；并利用累计状态更新幅度和预测置信度触发动态状态重置，同时配合anchor-to-world对齐恢复状态可塑性。
result: 在相机位姿估计、视频深度估计和3D重建任务上均取得一致提升，并显著缓解长序列性能退化；在KITTI Odometry上，平均ATE相比LongStream降低1.68倍。
conclusion: Info3R为在线3D重建提供了一种信息自适应测试时训练框架，增强了长序列与户外扩展场景下的鲁棒性，具有实际部署潜力。

title: SFVO: Decoupled Confidence-Guided Stereo-Flow Visual Odometry with Bidirectional PnP
abstract: Deep learning-based visual odometry (VO) has achieved significant progress, yet most existing methods focus on a monocular approach, which suffers from scale ambiguity. Stereo VO provides real metric by its nature, but remains less studied in deep learning VO due to its high computational cost and modeling complexity. Recent advances in stereo matching and optical flow estimation have made dense visual correspondence increasingly accurate and reliable, but their complementary geometric information has not been fully exploited for VO. In this paper, we present SFVO, a correspondence-driven stereo VO framework that directly builds upon pretrained stereo matching and optical flow models. SFVO exploits pretrained stereo matching and optical flow models to estimate stereo and temporal correspondences. Instead of learning pose directly from images, SFVO maps learned correspondences into geometric constraints and predicts which points are trustworthy. To improve the reliability of visual correspondence-based geometric constraints, we introduce decoupled confidence maps for rotation and translation. This design better aligns the characteristics of visual correspondence and 6-DoF transformations. Extensive experiments on outdoor and indoor datasets demonstrate that SFVO achieves robust and accurate pose estimation with strong generalization capability. The code will be released.
tldr: SFVO复用预训练双目匹配与光流构建几何约束，并用旋转/平移解耦置信图引导双向PnP，实现鲁棒双目视觉里程计。
motivation: 现有深度学习视觉里程计多集中于单目方案，存在尺度模糊问题；双目视觉里程计天然提供真实尺度，但因计算成本高和建模复杂而在深度学习中研究不足。此外，双目匹配与光流估计虽日益准确，其互补几何信息尚未在VO中被充分挖掘。
method: SFVO以预训练双目匹配和光流模型估计双目与时序对应关系，不直接从图像学习位姿，而是将对应关系转化为几何约束并预测哪些点可信。为更好匹配视觉对应与6-DoF变换特性，方法引入旋转和平移解耦的置信图，并结合双向PnP求解位姿。
result: 在室外和室内数据集上的大量实验表明，SFVO能实现鲁棒、准确的位姿估计，并具有较强泛化能力；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: SFVO提出了一种对应关系驱动的双目视觉里程计框架，通过复用预训练匹配/光流模型并解耦置信度引导几何约束，缓解了单目尺度模糊和双目建模复杂问题。该工作为深度双目VO提供了可泛化的新思路，代码将开源。

title: HAT: Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking for Video Monocular Spacecraft Pose Estimation
abstract: Monocular 6-DoF pose estimation of non-cooperative targets is important for on-orbit servicing and debris removal. A single-image estimator can confuse near-symmetric spacecraft orientations, and tracking can preserve an incorrect pose. We present Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking (HAT), a causal framework that uses inter-frame motion to select among competing CAD-based pose hypotheses before alignment and fusion. Rather than independently choosing the highest-scoring hypothesis in each image, HAT retains competing orientation histories and selects a pose to anchor the relative trajectory estimated by monocular SLAM. Sparse anchors and pose fusion provide per-frame estimates after initialization without revising past outputs. The method requires only a calibrated RGB sequence, a metric CAD model, and target image regions, which can be supplied by detection or segmentation. The pretrained pose and SLAM networks require no target-specific training or fine-tuning. We evaluate two versions, Mega-HAT and Pico-HAT, using MegaPose and PicoPose, on SPARK-2024, SwissCube and SHIRT, with YCB-Video assessing performance outside the space domain. Using one temporal configuration per method, the arithmetic means of the four dataset-wise comparisons show 9.4% lower mean pose error and 3.76 times the sustained input FPS for Mega-HAT relative to independent MegaPose, and 23.9% lower mean pose error and 2.42 times the FPS for Pico-HAT relative to independent PicoPose. Mega-HAT ablations on SPARK and an offline reference examine component contributions and the effect of revising past estimates.
tldr: HAT 利用帧间运动在竞争位姿假设中选择锚点并结合 SLAM 融合，实现高效无目标训练的航天器单目位姿估计。
motivation: 非合作目标单目 6-DoF 位姿估计对在轨服务和碎片清除至关重要，但单图估计易混淆近对称航天器朝向，跟踪又可能持续保留错误位姿。HAT 旨在利用帧间运动在竞争假设中稳健选择并锚定位姿，避免错误累积。
method: HAT 是一个因果框架，保留多个候选朝向历史，在对 CAD 位姿假设进行对齐与融合前，利用帧间运动选择锚定假设，并用其锚定单目 SLAM 估计的相对轨迹；稀疏锚点和位姿融合在初始化后提供逐帧估计且不修改过去输出。方法仅需标定 RGB 序列、度量 CAD 模型和目标图像区域，预训练位姿与 SLAM 网络无需目标特定训练或微调。
result: 在 SPARK-2024、SwissCube、SHIRT 及 YCB-Video 上评估 Mega-HAT 和 Pico-HAT（分别基于 MegaPose 和 PicoPose）；四数据集比较的算术平均显示，Mega-HAT 较独立 MegaPose 平均位姿误差降低 9.4%、持续输入 FPS 为 3.76 倍，Pico-HAT 较独立 PicoPose 误差降低 23.9%、FPS 为 2.42 倍。SPARK 消融和离线参考进一步分析各组件贡献及修改过去估计的影响。
conclusion: HAT 在无需目标特定训练的情况下提升了单目航天器位姿估计精度与实时性，并通过假设锚定和位姿融合缓解近对称目标错误。该框架对在轨服务、碎片清除等空间应用具有潜在价值。

title: 2D GauSS-MI: Efficient Active Scene Reconstruction with Balanced Visual and Geometric Quality
abstract: Active reconstruction requires efficient active view selection to achieve high-quality reconstruction within limited onboard computational resources. Existing methods face challenges in adequately balancing visual and geometric quality with the computational efficiency required for real-time operation. In this work, we present an active reconstruction framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS). We develop an efficient online 2DGS mapping pipeline for incremental RGB-D observations and introduce a probabilistic reliability model that characterizes the view-dependent reconstruction quality of individual 2D Gaussian splats. Building on this model, we formulate 2D Gaussian Splatting Shannon Mutual Information (2D GauSS-MI), a mutual-information-based metric that exploits the explicit surface orientation of 2DGS to evaluate the expected information gain of candidate views. The proposed metric enables active view selection to account for both visual and geometric reconstruction quality. We evaluate the proposed system against three state-of-the-art baselines on eight Replica scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves a favorable balance between visual and geometric reconstruction quality with substantially lower computational cost and competitive model storage.
tldr: 提出基于2DGS的主动重建框架，用2D高斯香农互信息选视角，兼顾视觉与几何质量并降低计算成本。
motivation: 现有主动重建方法难以在有限机载计算资源下同时兼顾视觉质量、几何质量与实时运行效率，因此需要更高效的主动视角选择策略。
method: 构建面向增量RGB-D观测的在线2DGS建图流程，并引入概率可靠性模型刻画单个2D高斯溅射的视角相关重建质量；在此基础上提出2D GauSS-MI指标，利用2DGS显式表面朝向计算候选视角的期望信息增益，使主动视角选择同时考虑视觉与几何重建质量。
result: 在八个Replica场景上与三个最先进基线方法对比，实验表明该方法在视觉与几何重建质量之间取得良好平衡，同时计算成本显著降低，模型存储具有竞争力。
conclusion: 该工作将2DGS与互信息主动视角选择结合，实现了高效且质量均衡的主动场景重建，有望提升资源受限平台上的实时重建与自主探索能力。

title: Adaptive World Memory 3D Foundation Model for Scalable 3D Mapping, Localization, and Rendering
abstract: Recent 3D foundation models enable generalizable geometric reasoning from RGB images but remain limited in persistent memory, scalability, and renderable scene modeling. We present a memory-centric 3D foundation model for scalable robotic localization, reconstruction, and Gaussian rendering. Its core is an adaptive world memory mechanism that combines transformer-based gated updates with test-time temporal-spatial regulation. Learned gates control recurrent memory propagation, while temporal state evolution and spatial observation-state consistency regulate token-wise updates and forgetting over long image sequences. To support large-scale mapping, we organize memory into local submaps and integrate progressive mapping and tracking, loop closure, and SL(4)-based global refinement to maintain local accuracy and global consistency. A Gaussian reconstruction head decodes memory-enhanced features into renderable primitives, unifying camera pose estimation, dense point-cloud reconstruction, and photorealistic rendering within a single model. Experiments on public benchmarks and self-collected datasets from diverse robotic platforms demonstrate improved trajectory accuracy, reconstruction completeness, and rendering quality over existing 3D foundation reconstruction and SLAM baselines. These results support adaptive memory as a foundation for persistent robotic world modeling. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}.
tldr: 提出自适应世界记忆3D基础模型，统一可扩展建图、定位与高斯渲染。
motivation: 现有3D基础模型能从RGB图像进行可泛化几何推理，但在持久记忆、可扩展性和可渲染场景建模方面仍受限。本文旨在以自适应记忆为核心，支持机器人持久世界建模与大规模场景理解。
method: 核心是自适应世界记忆机制，将Transformer门控更新与测试时时空调节结合，用学习门控控制循环记忆传播，并用时间状态演化和空间观测-状态一致性调节长序列中的token级更新与遗忘。方法将记忆组织为局部子图，结合渐进建图跟踪、回环检测和SL(4)全局优化；高斯重建头将记忆增强特征解码为可渲染基元，统一相机位姿估计、稠密点云重建和逼真渲染。
result: 在公开基准和多种机器人平台自采数据集上，所提方法在轨迹精度、重建完整性和渲染质量上优于现有3D基础重建与SLAM基线；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明自适应记忆可作为持久机器人世界建模的基础，并在单一模型中统一定位、重建与渲染。数据集和代码将公开，有望推动可扩展3D建图与定位研究。

title: VoxelTTO: Voxel-Aligned Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Test-Time Optimization
abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods typically regress pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives, often causing excessive overlap and artifacts, while inaccuracies in predicted camera poses can lead to misalignment in novel-view synthesis (NVS). We present VoxelTTO, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing geometrically accurate 3DGS scenes from an arbitrary number of images and optional camera parameters. VoxelTTO aggregates dense image features into a global voxel representation and decodes Gaussians from voxel features, breaking the pixel-to-Gaussian correspondence. To exploit known camera parameters while keeping the pretrained visual foundation model (VFM) parameters frozen, we introduce test-time optimization (TTO) that adapts lightweight LoRA modules using pose supervision. We further replace vanilla 3DGS rasterization with stochastic solid volume rendering during training and inference, improving geometric fidelity. Training updates only the voxel-aligned Gaussian reconstruction modules, requiring 80 GPU hours. Experiments on Replica, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate improved RGB-D NVS and camera-pose estimation relative to prior methods.
tldr: VoxelTTO 用体素对齐高斯与测试时优化，提升前馈 3DGS 的几何精度、新视角合成和相机位姿估计。
motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法通常回归像素对齐的高斯基元，易造成过度重叠和伪影；同时预测相机位姿不准会导致新视角合成出现错位。VoxelTTO 旨在从任意数量图像和可选相机参数中重建几何精确的 3DGS 场景。
method: 该方法将密集图像特征聚合到全局体素表示，并从体素特征解码高斯，打破像素到高斯的对应关系；同时引入测试时优化，在冻结预训练视觉基础模型参数的情况下，用位姿监督适配轻量 LoRA 模块。训练和推理阶段还以随机实体体积渲染替代原生 3DGS 光栅化，仅更新体素对齐高斯重建模块，训练需 80 GPU 小时。
result: 在 Replica、Tanks and Temples 和 DTU 数据集上，VoxelTTO 相对先前方法提升了 RGB-D 新视角合成和相机位姿估计表现；训练成本为 80 GPU 小时。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VoxelTTO 提出体素对齐的前馈 3DGS 框架，通过测试时优化和随机实体体积渲染提升几何保真度与位姿鲁棒性，为前馈 3DGS 重建提供了一种可融合可选相机参数且不依赖像素对齐的新思路。

title: Think Locally, Refine Globally for Memory-Efficient 3D Reconstruction
abstract: We propose LoG-VGGT, a memory-efficient framework for long-sequence 3D reconstruction that balances local temporal modeling with global camera consistency. Instead of relying on full global attention, our method introduces cross-window attention at a small subset of transformer blocks, enabling effective information propagation across adjacent temporal windows while keeping memory usage bounded. To mitigate long-term pose drift, we further design a global camera consistency refinement module, where camera tokens interact with compact register tokens via cross-attention to enforce scene-level constraints across the entire sequence. This design enables joint optimization of camera representations and significantly improves long-horizon pose stability without incurring the high cost of sequence-wide attention. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoG-VGGT achieves improved depth accuracy and robust camera pose estimation across multiple long-sequence benchmarks, while delivering competitive streaming reconstruction performance.
tldr: 提出 LoG-VGGT，结合跨窗口注意力与全局相机一致性精炼，实现内存高效的长序列三维重建。
motivation: 长序列三维重建中，全全局注意力会带来高昂内存开销，而长期相机位姿漂移也会影响稳定性。该方法旨在有限内存下兼顾局部时序建模与全局相机一致性。
method: LoG-VGGT 仅在少量 Transformer 块中引入跨窗口注意力，使信息在相邻时间窗口间传播并保持内存有界；同时设计全局相机一致性精炼模块，让相机 token 与紧凑 register token 通过交叉注意力交互，在整个序列上施加场景级约束并联合优化相机表示，避免全序列注意力的高成本。
result: 在多个长序列基准上，LoG-VGGT 提升了深度精度与相机位姿估计鲁棒性，并展现出有竞争力的流式重建性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明局部窗口注意力与全局相机精炼的结合能有效缓解长期位姿漂移，在内存受限条件下实现高效长序列三维重建。该框架为长序列与流式三维重建提供了可扩展方案。

title: WS-NeRF: A Mamba-Driven World-State-Aware Adaptive Deblurring Neural Radiance Field
abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have attracted extensive attention in recent years due to their strong capability for high-quality 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis from multi-view images. Existing methods usually rely on high-quality sharp inputs, while real-world image acquisition is highly susceptible to blur degradation, which severely affects the reconstruction quality of NeRF. In this paper, we propose a novel Mamba-driven world-state-aware adaptive deblurring neural radiance field, termed WS-NeRF, to address image degradation and 3D inconsistency. We formulate the alternating optimization of radiance fields as a dynamic evolution process with temporal memory, and jointly exploit comprehensive multi-dimensional world states and a mixture-of-experts mechanism to dynamically adjust the confidence of deblurring priors. Experimental results show that WS-NeRF significantly improves blurry radiance field reconstruction quality, achieving better performance on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while exhibiting more stable iterative recovery behavior.
tldr: 提出 Mamba 驱动的世界状态感知自适应去模糊 NeRF，以提升模糊输入下的三维重建质量。
motivation: 现有 NeRF 方法通常依赖高质量清晰输入，而真实场景图像采集易受模糊退化影响，严重降低 NeRF 的重建质量。研究旨在同时解决图像退化与三维不一致问题。
method: 提出 WS-NeRF，将辐射场的交替优化建模为带时间记忆的动态演化过程，并联合利用多维世界状态与混合专家机制动态调整去模糊先验置信度。该方法由 Mamba 驱动，实现自适应去模糊与辐射场重建的协同优化。
result: 实验表明 WS-NeRF 显著提升模糊辐射场重建质量，在 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 上取得更好表现，并呈现更稳定的迭代恢复行为；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: WS-NeRF 通过 Mamba、世界状态感知与自适应去模糊先验提升模糊输入下 NeRF 的重建质量与稳定性，为真实场景鲁棒三维重建提供新思路。

title: Cube-Splat: High-Fidelity 360° Gaussian Splatting SLAM via Cubemap Factorization and Adjoint-Consistent Optimization
abstract: Recent progress in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled dense visual SLAM with pinhole cameras, yet most pipelines are not designed for panoramic imagery. We present Cube-Splat, the first panoramic GS-SLAM framework that factorizes each 360° frame into a cubemap of four fixed-orientation virtual pinhole views sharing a single optical center. By designating the front face as the primary pose state, we accumulate gradients from all faces via an adjoint mapping, thereby enabling multi-face observations to coherently update a single state while strictly preserving cross-view geometric consistency. Concurrently, our mapping module densifies and optimizes anisotropic Gaussians using aggregated cubemap rays for high-fidelity, dense reconstruction. Furthermore, to rigorously evaluate panoramic SLAM under diverse and challenging conditions, we introduce SynPano, a highly scalable, photorealistic synthetic dataset featuring parameterized complex trajectories and multi-modal ground truth. Extensive evaluations on two public benchmarks (PALVIO and OmniBlender) and our SynPano dataset, collectively encompassing both indoor and outdoor scenes, demonstrate that Cube-Splat achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in tracking accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Both the source code and the SynPano dataset are available at https://github.com/guoxf304/CubeSplat.
tldr: Cube-Splat 首次将全景图像分解为四路立方体贴图，并通过伴随映射实现高保真 360° 高斯泼溅 SLAM。
motivation: 现有 3DGS SLAM 多面向针孔相机，缺乏针对全景图像设计的管线。该工作旨在解决 360° 全景 SLAM 中多视图几何一致性保持与高保真稠密重建的难题。
method: 将每帧 360° 图像分解为共享单一光心的四个固定朝向虚拟针孔视图，以前面为主位姿状态，通过伴随映射聚合所有面的梯度，使多面观测一致更新单一状态并严格保持跨视图几何一致性。建图模块利用聚合立方体贴图光线稠密化并优化各向异性高斯，同时提出可扩展的写实合成数据集 SynPano，包含参数化复杂轨迹和多模态真值。
result: 在 PALVIO、OmniBlender 两个公开基准及自建 SynPano 数据集上（涵盖室内外场景）评估，Cube-Splat 在跟踪精度和重建保真度上均达到 SOTA；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: Cube-Splat 是首个全景 GS-SLAM 框架，核心贡献为立方体贴图分解与伴随一致优化，并发布 SynPano 数据集；源码与数据已开源，有望推动 360° SLAM 的高保真重建研究。

title: FOCAL-VLA: Subtask-Guided Geometry Distillation and Implicit World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models built on pretrained vision-language models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, VLA models that directly map current 2D observations to actions often lack sufficient spatial and temporal understanding, limiting their performance in precise and long-horizon manipulation. Recent methods enhance VLA models through geometric supervision and future-state prediction across the entire scene. However, these methods can suffer from redundant scene information, distracting the model from learning the geometry and dynamics relevant to the current interaction. To address this issue, we propose FOCAL-VLA, a framework that combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to learn representations of current spatial structure and future interaction dynamics. To focus geometric learning on the current subtask, we transfer geometric knowledge from VGGT to the VLA model by aligning geometry latents with features from subtask-relevant image regions. To capture the future 3D evolution of the current interaction, we incorporate implicit world modeling using Track4World features from current and future demonstration frames. The two complementary representations jointly guide action generation without running VGGT or Track4World at inference time. Experiments show that FOCAL-VLA outperforms baselines on both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. Project website: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/FOCAL-VLA/.
tldr: FOCAL-VLA通过子任务引导几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模，提升视觉-语言-动作模型的空间与长时程操作能力。
motivation: 现有VLA模型直接将当前2D观测映射为动作，空间与时序理解不足；全场景几何监督和未来状态预测又引入冗余信息，干扰当前交互相关几何与动力学的学习。
method: FOCAL-VLA将VGGT的几何知识蒸馏到VLA模型，通过将几何隐变量与子任务相关图像区域特征对齐，实现子任务引导的几何学习；同时利用当前与未来示范帧的Track4World特征进行隐式世界建模，以预测当前交互的未来3D演化，两种表示联合指导动作生成且推理时无需运行VGGT或Track4World。
result: 实验表明，FOCAL-VLA在仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务上均优于基线方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法通过子任务聚焦的几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模，在不增加推理开销的情况下增强VLA的空间与时序理解，为精准长时程操作提供了有效方案，并展示了仿真与真实场景的泛化潜力。

title: VGGT-CAD: Reconstructing Parametric CAD 3D Model with Geometric Grounding
abstract: Parametric CAD reconstruction requires recovering both precise geometry and editable modeling operations from visual observations, making it challenging under limited and ambiguous views. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D appearance cues and lack strong multi-view geometric priors. In this work, we present VGGT-CAD, a geometry-aware framework for parametric CAD reconstruction from single- and multi-view observations. We transfer pretrained 3D geometric priors into CAD reconstruction by encoding camera parameters as condition tokens and jointly modeling them with image tokens. To handle varying numbers of viewpoints, we introduce a variable-view cross-view context aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-view features. We further develop a training-free geometry-aware view selection strategy to select complementary and reliable frames during inference. The resulting representation is decoded into CAD command sequences using a non-autoregressive decoder. We also develop VideoCAD, a large-scale multi-view video benchmark derived from existing CAD data through multi-view re-rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VGGT-CAD for visual CAD reconstruction under different observation configurations.
tldr: VGGT-CAD利用预训练3D几何先验与变视角聚合，从单/多视图重建可编辑参数化CAD模型。
motivation: 现有参数化CAD重建方法主要依赖2D外观线索，缺乏强多视图几何先验，在有限且模糊视角下难以同时恢复精确几何与可编辑建模操作。
method: 提出VGGT-CAD，将预训练3D几何先验迁移至CAD重建，把相机参数编码为条件token并与图像token联合建模；设计可变视角跨视图上下文聚合模块自适应融合多视图特征，并采用免训练几何感知视角选择策略；最终通过非自回归解码器输出CAD命令序列。
result: 构建了由现有CAD数据多视图重渲染得到的VideoCAD大规模多视图视频基准；大量实验表明VGGT-CAD在不同观测配置下均能有效完成视觉CAD重建，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VGGT-CAD为视觉参数化CAD重建提供了几何感知框架，可处理单视图、多视图及可变视角输入，并贡献VideoCAD基准，对可编辑CAD逆向建模与多视图3D理解具有潜在影响。

title: Robust Structureless Monocular Visual Inertial Initialization Exploiting Line Features and Vanishing Points
abstract: Accurate initialization is essential for reliable visual-inertial odometry (VIO), but it is often ill-conditioned under degenerate motions. Existing methods typically require restrictive excitation motions to ensure sufficient observability or rely on computationally expensive 3D structure reconstruction, limiting efficient and practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose SLIM-init, a structureless monocular VIO initializer that directly exploits geometric constraints from tracked 2D line features without explicit 3D landmark reconstruction. Specifically, SLIM-init leverages line-derived vanishing points (VPs) as translation-invariant orientation cues to provide robust rotation-only constraints under degenerate scenarios such as low-parallax or translation-dominant motions. It further incorporates a line epipolar residual to constrain translation and a line-normal projection residual to improve the conditioning of linear alignment, enhancing the accuracy and robustness of initial state estimation. Extensive experiments on a public benchmark and challenging custom degenerate-motion sequences demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over state-of-the-art initialization methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/cjunwan/SLIM-init.
tldr: 提出SLIM-init，利用线特征与消失点实现无结构单目视觉惯性鲁棒初始化。
motivation: 单目VIO初始化在退化运动下常病态；现有方法需强激励运动或昂贵的3D结构重建，难以兼顾效率与实用性。
method: SLIM-init无需显式3D路标重建，直接利用跟踪的2D线特征几何约束：以线导出的消失点提供平移不变的旋转约束，以线对极残差约束平移，并用线法向投影残差改善线性对齐条件数。
result: 在公开基准和自建挑战性退化运动序列上，SLIM-init相比最先进初始化方法在精度和鲁棒性上均有提升；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法为退化运动下的单目VIO提供无需3D重建的高效初始化方案，代码已开源，有望提升实际部署的鲁棒性。

title: 4DGS-Fixer: Generative Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting with Iterative Refinement Guided by Video Diffusion Priors
abstract: This paper addresses the challenges of dynamic scene synthesis from sparse-view videos. Existing methods employ geometric priors, adaptive optimization, or density-control strategies to improve 4D Gaussian modeling under sparse observations. However, they cannot fundamentally resolve the ill-posed problem caused by insufficient observations and missing scene information. Moreover, sparse-view 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) often suffers from poor geometric initialization: with only a few input views, COLMAP typically reconstructs sparse and incomplete point clouds, leaving large scene regions without sufficient Gaussian support and making them difficult to recover through subsequent optimization. To address these limitations, we propose a novel iterative refinement framework based on a video diffusion model to improve the completeness and consistency of dynamic 4D scenes. Specifically, we first estimate multi-view depth maps and fuse them into dense point clouds to provide more complete geometric initialization for a dynamic 4DGS representation. We then employ a pretrained video restoration model to refine sequences rendered along novel camera trajectories at different time steps. The restored sequences serve as pseudo-supervision to regularize and iteratively refine the 4DGS representation. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing baselines, achieving nearly a 2 dB PSNR improvement over the previous best-performing method.
tldr: 提出4DGS-Fixer，利用视频扩散先验与迭代细化，从稀疏视图视频生成完整一致的动态4D高斯场景。
motivation: 稀疏视图动态场景合成本质病态，现有几何先验、自适应优化或密度控制无法从根本上解决观测不足与场景信息缺失；同时COLMAP点云稀疏不完整导致4DGS几何初始化差，大片区域缺乏高斯支撑且难以优化恢复。
method: 先估计多视角深度图并融合为稠密点云，为动态4DGS提供更完整几何初始化；再利用预训练视频修复模型细化沿新相机轨迹、不同时间步渲染的序列，并将修复序列作为伪监督迭代正则化与优化4DGS表示。
result: 在常用基准数据集上显著优于现有基线，相比此前最佳方法实现近2 dB的PSNR提升。
conclusion: 该框架通过视频扩散先验引导的伪监督迭代修复，缓解稀疏视图4DGS的病态性与几何初始化不足，提升动态场景完整性与一致性，为稀疏视图动态重建提供新思路。

title: SplashSplat: Reconstructing Splashing Liquids from Real-World Multi-View Videos
abstract: A splash lives for a fraction of a second: sheets tear into ligaments and droplets, appearance is view-dependent and nearly textureless, and little persists long enough to track. Reconstruction research has consequently focused on smoke, synthetic liquids, or gently deforming surfaces. To our knowledge, no synchronized multi-view dataset of splashing liquids exists. We therefore introduce a benchmark of 20 real scenes, from coherent streams to violent splashes, captured by seven synchronized, calibrated 4K cameras at 60 fps, with manually refined per-view liquid and container masks and fixed evaluation splits. We further present SplashSplat, built on a single principle: impose physical structure only where the observations can constrain it. Per-frame liquid SDFs fused from the masks provide the geometry, level-set transport between consecutive SDFs yields a coarse velocity field, and Lagrangian carriers advected along this flow, corrected against each new observation and reseeded where coverage is lost, decode local Gaussians for differentiable rendering. SplashSplat outperforms state-of-the-art dynamic Gaussian splatting methods on our real captures and on a synthetic benchmark, with physically more plausible motion and a lower training cost. The same representation supports temporal interpolation and style transfer without re-optimization.
tldr: 提出首个真实多视角飞溅液体数据集，并用物理约束的SplashSplat实现动态高斯重建。
motivation: 飞溅液体仅持续瞬间，液片会撕裂成韧带和液滴，表观视角依赖且近乎无纹理，难以长期追踪；现有重建研究多集中于烟雾、合成液体或缓慢形变表面。据作者所知，此前不存在同步多视角的飞溅液体数据集。
method: 构建包含20个真实场景的基准，涵盖连贯水流到剧烈飞溅，使用7台同步标定4K相机以60fps拍摄，并提供逐视角精修液体与容器掩码及固定评估划分。提出SplashSplat，仅在观测可约束处施加物理结构：由掩码融合逐帧液体SDF作为几何，通过相邻SDF间水平集传输得到粗速度场，并沿流场平流拉格朗日载体，经新观测校正、覆盖丢失处重播种后解码局部高斯进行可微渲染。
result: 在真实捕获和合成基准上，SplashSplat优于最先进的动态高斯泼溅方法，具有更合理的物理运动和更低的训练成本；同一表示还支持无需重优化的时间插值与风格迁移。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 贡献包括首个同步多视角飞溅液体基准数据集与按观测约束施加物理结构的SplashSplat框架，为真实飞溅液体动态重建、时间插值和风格迁移提供统一表示，并有望推动复杂流体场景的可微分重建研究。

title: PhGS: Post-Hoc Pruning and Refinement of Single-View Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Reconstructions
abstract: Recent single-view feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) generation predicts a fixed number of Gaussians per camera ray, introducing severe spatial redundancy. Most existing compaction strategies target multi-view setups to exploit cross-view consistency and are incompatible with single-image models. Instead of retraining the base feed-forward network to directly output compact representations, our insight is to keep the base models frozen and apply post-hoc pruning and recurrent refinement to the generated Gaussians. Consequently, we propose a backbone-agnostic compaction pipeline for single-view feed-forward 3DGS that couples an importance-score-based pruning mechanism with a trainable, lightweight recurrent refinement module, which iteratively updates the surviving primitives to restore image quality. Our results demonstrate seamless integration with existing baselines while preserving novel-view rendering fidelity and achieving high memory reduction. Furthermore, our method supports flexible inference-time keep ratios for application needs.
tldr: PhGS 对单视图前馈 3DGS 生成结果进行事后剪枝与循环精炼，在保持渲染质量的同时大幅降低内存。
motivation: 单视图前馈 3DGS 沿每条相机射线预测固定数量高斯，造成严重空间冗余；现有压缩方法面向多视图依赖跨视图一致性，无法直接用于单图模型。
method: 提出与主干无关的事后压缩管线：冻结基础前馈网络，基于重要性评分剪枝生成的高斯，并用轻量可训练循环精炼模块迭代更新存活图元以恢复图像质量；支持推理时灵活设置保留比例。
result: 摘要显示方法可与现有基线无缝集成，保持新视角渲染保真度并实现高内存压缩，且支持按应用需求调整推理时保留比率；具体压缩率与质量指标未给出量化数值。
conclusion: PhGS 无需重训练基础模型即可压缩单视图前馈 3DGS，提供骨干无关、支持可变保留率的通用方案，有助于推动单图三维重建在内存受限场景落地。

title: RawSLAM: Online HDR Gaussian SLAM from Linear Radiance
abstract: Current dense visual SLAM systems rely almost exclusively on 8-bit tonemapped Low Dynamic Range (LDR) inputs, limiting their robustness in extreme lighting where shadows and highlights trigger tracking drift and mapping collapse. Conversely, existing raw and High Dynamic Range (HDR) reconstruction pipelines operate strictly offline. They depend on Structure-from-Motion preprocessing and are not suited for large inter-frame motion. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first online Gaussian SLAM framework that tracks and maps directly on single-exposure 16-bit linear HDR imagery. Our method rests on three core components: an architecture-agnostic HDR Gaussian Splatting module featuring an MLP-free logarithmic parameterization of Gaussian color features; a Reinhard range-compressed photometric objective; and structure-guided spatial gradient weighting. Combined, these components allow our approach to outperform a direct HDR adaptation of MonoGS in both trajectory and reconstruction accuracy, while rendering natively in linear scene radiance for post-rendering processing. The same formulation runs unchanged on standard 8-bit inputs, roughly halving the MonoGS baseline error. Furthermore, our HDR Gaussian module transfers seamlessly to SplaTAM, Gaussian SLAM, and DROID-W, eliminating all tracking failures these systems suffer on challenging illumination sequences. To enable this research, we introduce RawSLAM: a dataset of 10 real-world indoor sequences featuring 16-bit RAW imagery, aligned depth, IMU measurements, and external OptiTrack poses. Code and dataset will be made publicly available soon.
tldr: 提出首个在线16位线性HDR高斯SLAM框架RawSLAM，并发布配套RAW数据集。
motivation: 现有密集视觉SLAM几乎仅使用8位色调映射LDR输入，在极端光照下易因阴影和高光导致跟踪漂移与建图崩溃；而现有RAW/HDR重建流程均为离线，依赖SfM预处理且难以应对大帧间运动。
method: 本文提出首个在线高斯SLAM框架，直接在单曝光16位线性HDR图像上跟踪与建图。核心包括架构无关的HDR高斯泼溅模块（无MLP的对数参数化高斯颜色特征）、Reinhard范围压缩光度目标，以及结构引导的空间梯度加权。
result: 该方法在轨迹与重建精度上超过MonoGS的直接HDR适配版本，并可原生渲染线性场景辐射度；同一公式在标准8位输入上仍使MonoGS基线误差约减半。HDR高斯模块可无缝迁移至SplaTAM、Gaussian SLAM和DROID-W，消除这些系统在挑战性光照序列上的全部跟踪失败；同时发布RawSLAM数据集，含10个真实室内序列的16位RAW、对齐深度、IMU和OptiTrack位姿。
conclusion: 本文实现了首个在线、直接基于线性HDR辐射度的高斯SLAM，为极端光照下鲁棒SLAM提供新方案，并通过开源数据集推动RAW/HDR SLAM研究。

title: CoRef-GS: Cooperative Referring Gaussian Splatting for Multi-Agent Scene Understanding
abstract: Referring scene understanding for embodied robots requires grounding object- and relation-centric language queries from a designated viewpoint. While a local semantic Gaussian map can support such grounding within one agent's observations, cooperative settings require this ability to remain effective after independently reconstructed maps are aligned and fused. In this setting, the referred target or its contextual landmark may come from another agent's observations, while spatial relations must still be interpreted from the querying robot's viewpoint. We formulate this problem as cooperative referring Gaussian grounding over fused maps, which requires geometric alignability, instance-level semantic comparability, and view-conditioned relation reasoning. Existing language-aware Gaussian methods mainly focus on single-map querying, whereas Gaussian registration methods optimize geometric or photometric alignment without preserving language-grounding-oriented semantic compatibility. We propose CoRef-GS, a cooperative referring Gaussian splatting framework. CoRef-GS constructs local open-vocabulary instance-aware Gaussian maps, then aligns partially overlapping maps with a cross-agent alignment module by geometric and semantic consistency, and grounds queries using a view-conditioned mask relation graph. We further introduce CoQuad-Ref, a dual-quadruped benchmark spanning both real-world and simulated indoor scenes. Experiments show that, on simulated scenes, CoRef-GS reduces the rotation error from 2.58° after coarse initialization to 0.15° after refinement, and improves real-world referring mIoU over ReferSplat from 52.6% to 68.8%. The established benchmark and source code will be publicly released at https://github.com/ruojiruoli17/CoRef-GS.git.
tldr: 提出 CoRef-GS 协作指代高斯泼溅框架，支持多智能体融合地图上的视角条件场景理解。
motivation: 单智能体的语言高斯地图难以直接支持协同场景：独立重建地图融合后，被指代目标或上下文地标可能来自其他智能体观测，而空间关系仍须从查询机器人视角解释。现有语言高斯方法多面向单地图查询，高斯配准方法也偏重几何或光度对齐，未保持语言接地所需的语义兼容性。
method: CoRef-GS 先构建局部开放词汇、实例感知的高斯地图，再通过跨智能体对齐模块利用几何与语义一致性对齐部分重叠地图，最后使用视角条件 mask 关系图完成查询接地。作者还提出双四足机器人基准 CoQuad-Ref，覆盖真实与仿真室内场景。
result: 仿真场景中，CoRef-GS 将旋转误差从粗初始化后的 2.58° 降至细化后的 0.15°；真实世界指代 mIoU 从 ReferSplat 的 52.6% 提升至 68.8%。
conclusion: 该工作验证了在融合高斯地图上进行协作指代接地的可行性，并贡献了跨智能体语义对齐与视角条件关系推理框架。CoQuad-Ref 基准和源代码将公开，有望推动多机器人具身场景理解研究。

title: EliGSiR: Continual RGB-D Mapping with Gaussian Splatting under Bounded Compute
abstract: Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting assumes a closed set of observations and long optimization schedules. Continual RGB-D mapping in contrast poses the problem that new observations arrive online, while previously reconstructed regions must be preserved. We present EliGSiR (Evidence-guided Load-adaptive Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Image Replay), a continual Gaussian mapper that controls how the available optimization budget is used as the reconstruction evolves. Map-Guided View Scheduling filters redundant incoming views and reconsiders retained views according to the current state of the map. Load-Adaptive Fidelity adjusts supervision resolution to the current mapping load instead of following a fixed resolution schedule. Targeted Geometry Growth separates depth supervision from Gaussian creation and adds geometric capacity only where repeated RGB-D observations indicate missing or misplaced structure. Together, these mechanisms adapt which views are optimized, how much image detail is used, and where the representation grows while mapping remains active. We evaluate EliGSiR on Replica, TUM RGB-D, ScanNet++, and real RGB-D sensor sequences, considering both the final reconstruction and the map available throughout acquisition. On TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household, EliGSiR reaches 21.52 dB with the same ground-truth mapping poses used by the controlled baselines, compared with 19.42 dB for SplaTAM. In the tracked-pose comparison, EliGSiR with live ORB-SLAM3 poses reaches 23.02 dB in 155.5 s, compared with 20.10 dB in 230.9 s for CaRtGS using its native tracker. We further evaluate reconstruction throughout acquisition and show how EliGSiR adaptive view scheduling, supervision fidelity, and geometry growth improve the use of the available mapping budget.
tldr: EliGSiR 以证据引导、负载自适应和图像回放实现有限算力下的持续 RGB-D 高斯泼溅建图。
motivation: 传统 3D Gaussian Splatting 假设观测集合封闭且优化周期固定，难以应对新观测在线到达同时必须保留已重建区域的持续 RGB-D 建图需求；核心问题是在有界算力下平衡新视图优化与历史地图保持。
method: 提出 EliGSiR（Evidence-guided Load-adaptive Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Image Replay），其 Map-Guided View Scheduling 过滤冗余新视图并依据当前地图状态重审保留视图，Load-Adaptive Fidelity 按当前建图负载动态调整监督分辨率，Targeted Geometry Growth 将深度监督与高斯创建解耦并仅在重复 RGB-D 观测指示结构缺失或错位处增加几何容量；三者共同决定优化哪些视图、使用多少图像细节以及表示在何处增长。
result: 在 Replica、TUM RGB-D、ScanNet++ 和真实 RGB-D 序列上评估。TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household 使用与受控基线相同的地面真值位姿达 21.52 dB，优于 SplaTAM 的 19.42 dB；在跟踪位姿对比中，EliGSiR 使用实时 ORB-SLAM3 位姿达 23.02 dB、155.5 s，优于 CaRtGS 使用其原生跟踪器的 20.10 dB、230.9 s；采集过程中的重建评估表明自适应视图调度、监督保真度和几何增长改善了可用建图预算的利用。
conclusion: EliGSiR 可在有界算力下实现在线持续 RGB-D 高斯建图，在保持历史区域的同时提升重建精度与效率，相较 SplaTAM 和 CaRtGS 取得更优精度-时间权衡，为在线 RGB-D 高斯泼溅建图提供了可扩展方案。

title: GRF-Recon: Global Ray-Field Optimization for Long-Sequence Feed-forward Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction provides an efficient paradigm for scene modeling from image sequences. Scaling these models to large monocular scenarios are constrained by excessive GPU memory footprint, degraded local geometry, and long-term trajectory drift. Existing chunk-based optimization strategies provide limited geometric constraints and fail to maintain global consistency over extended trajectories. We present a unified framework for stable and scalable feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long monocular sequences. Our approach builds on coarse-to-fine trajectory alignment augmented by lightweight geometric prior injection. Distilling monocular geometric cues into the feed-forward backbone via LoRA adaptation improves depth accuracy on fine structures while preserving inference efficiency. We introduce a hybrid-weight sparse ray-field optimization that leverages high-frequency geometric features to guide local point-cloud refinement and enforce consistent inter-frame ray constraints. Unlike prior chunk-based methods, this establishes strong cross-frame geometric coupling while maintaining scalability. Finally, an efficient trajectory stitching strategy with joint ray-error optimization explicitly reduces accumulated drift. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves competitive trajectory accuracy compared with representative SLAM systems, while maintaining globally consistent 3D reconstruction in large-scale scenarios.
tldr: 提出GRF-Recon，用全局射线场优化与轨迹拼接实现长序列前馈3D重建，兼顾精度与可扩展性。
motivation: 前馈3D重建效率高，但扩展到大规模单目长序列时受限于GPU显存、局部几何退化和长期轨迹漂移；现有分块优化策略几何约束有限，难以在长轨迹上保持全局一致性。
method: 提出统一框架：粗到细轨迹对齐结合轻量几何先验注入，通过LoRA适配将单目几何线索蒸馏进前馈主干以提升精细结构深度精度；引入混合权重稀疏射线场优化，利用高频几何特征引导局部点云细化并施加跨帧射线约束；最后用联合射线误差优化的轨迹拼接策略显式减小累积漂移。
result: 大量实验表明，该方法在大规模场景中保持全局一致的3D重建，轨迹精度与代表性SLAM系统具有竞争力；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GRF-Recon为长单目序列提供了稳定且可扩展的前馈3D重建方案，通过全局射线场优化和轨迹拼接缓解漂移与局部退化，有望推动大规模前馈重建与SLAM的融合。

title: GS-PI: An Optimization-Decoupled Appearance Decomposition Approach for Generating PBR Gaussian Assets
abstract: Gaussian Splatting (GS) excels at novel-view synthesis but encodes baked-in radiance, tightly entangling illumination with geometry and preventing seamless integration into physically based rendering (PBR) pipelines. Existing inverse-rendering methods attempt to disentangle materials via joint optimization, but often suffer from competing objectives that cause severe ambiguities and residual lighting artifacts. To overcome this, we present GS-PI, a novel optimization-decoupled framework that casts PBR material generation as a geometry-conditioned diffusion process on 3D point clouds. By operating directly in the 3D domain, our method inherently guarantees multi-view consistency, sidestepping the severe pixel correspondence issues that challenge 2D diffusion approaches. We introduce a multi-scale cross-view conditioning mechanism that integrates three complementary components: a global semantic prior, source-anchored photometric cues, and an absolute spatial learned view-direction conditioning signal. This design efficiently compresses complex multi-view evidence, mitigating cross-view projection misalignment and successfully preventing specular highlights from baking into intrinsic colors. By extracting a point cloud from a pre-trained Gaussian model, predicting PBR attributes via conditional diffusion, and distilling them back through differentiable rasterisation, we yield a fully relightable PBR-GS asset. GS-PI outperforms recent inverse-rendering baselines while replacing per-scene joint illumination/BRDF optimization with a learned diffusion pass followed by a short target-driven distillation, without requiring proxy meshes.
tldr: GS-PI将PBR材质生成解耦为点云条件扩散，产出可重光照的PBR-GS资产。
motivation: Gaussian Splatting擅长新视角合成，但其烘焙辐射将光照与几何纠缠，难以直接接入PBR管线；现有逆渲染方法通过联合优化解耦材质，却常因目标竞争导致严重歧义与残留光照伪影。
method: GS-PI提出优化解耦框架，将PBR材质生成视为3D点云上的几何条件扩散过程，从而天然保证多视角一致性。其多尺度跨视角条件机制融合全局语义先验、源锚定光度线索和绝对空间学习视角方向条件；具体从预训练高斯模型提取点云，用条件扩散预测PBR属性，再经可微光栅化蒸馏回高斯表示，无需代理网格。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；仅定性声称GS-PI优于近期逆渲染基线，并用一次学习式扩散加短时目标驱动蒸馏替代逐场景联合光照/BRDF优化，且无需代理网格。
conclusion: GS-PI通过解耦优化与3D域条件扩散，缓解了跨视角投影错位和镜面高光烘焙问题，生成完全可重光照的PBR-GS资产，有望促进高斯资产无缝集成到PBR渲染管线。

title: SlugTrails: An Egocentric Benchmark for Floor Plan Localization in Large Buildings
abstract: Floor-plan-based indoor visual localization enables infrastructure-free positioning, but most methods are developed and evaluated in small residential environments unlike the large public buildings of real deployment. We introduce SlugTrails, a floor plan localization benchmark for large indoor spaces under realistic egocentric sensing: $30$ Hz Aria glasses recordings across three campus buildings and six floors ($22089$ m$^2$ of floor plan outline), CAD-derived floor plans with semantic classes and circulation space masks, and trajectories aligned into the floor plan frame using laser-surveyed anchors. One protocol covers three practical ways of gathering geometry under a limited field of view -- a single walking frame, a stationary multi-view sweep, and a walking stream with odometry -- so methods designed for different regimes are compared on the same buildings and ground truth. Evaluating five representative geometric and learned systems under their native sensing configurations, we find that stock checkpoints (official released weights) are near zero on SlugTrails (at most $0.004$ R@1m30$^{\circ}$ on walking single frames), while fine-tuning on SlugTrails improves every trainable family on all three tasks (e.g., F$^3$Loc $0.0 \rightarrow 0.141$ single-frame and $0.03 \rightarrow 0.66$ sequential), with gains compounding as observations accumulate. The same fine-tuned weights also improve cross-dataset generalization on LaMAR with no LaMAR training (sequential R@1m $0.048 \rightarrow 0.143$ for F$^3$Loc and $0.063 \rightarrow 0.127$ for UnLoc), whereas train-from-scratch on SlugTrails alone stays far below fine-tuning from stock weights -- evidence that floor plan localization is currently limited by indoor data rather than by architecture. We release the dataset, protocols, and tools at https://github.com/Head-inthe-Cloud/SlugTrails.
tldr: 提出SlugTrails：面向大型建筑的全新平面图定位基准，含Aria眼动数据与CAD平面图，揭示现有模型零样本失效、微调后显著提升。
motivation: 现有平面图定位方法多在小型住宅环境开发与评估，而真实部署面向大型公共建筑，缺乏逼真的第一视角大规模基准。
method: 构建SlugTrails基准：覆盖3栋校园建筑6层、22089平方米平面图，包含30Hz Aria眼镜记录、带语义与流通空间掩码的CAD平面图，以及激光锚点对齐的轨迹；设计单帧行走、静止多视角扫描、带里程计行走流三种协议，并评估五种几何与学习方法。
result: 现成权重在SlugTrails上近乎零样本失效（单帧行走R@1m30°最高仅0.004），微调后在三个任务上均提升，如F³Loc单帧0.0→0.141、序列0.03→0.66；微调权重零LaMAR训练即提升跨数据集泛化（序列R@1m：F³Loc 0.048→0.143，UnLoc 0.063→0.127），而从零训练远低于微调。
conclusion: 结果表明平面图定位当前受限于室内数据而非架构，发布数据集、协议与工具以推动大场景无基础设施定位研究。

title: PART: Learning 3D Part Assembly and Retrieval with Transformers
abstract: 3D assembly is fundamental to modern manufacturing and digital content creation. In this paper, we present PART, a unified transformer-based framework for 3D part retrieval and assembly: given a target shape and a part library, PART automatically selects the appropriate parts and predicts their 6-DoF poses to reconstruct the target. While prior work has achieved impressive progress on assembling a pre-defined set of parts, this more practical retrieval-based setting remains largely unexplored. The task faces three key challenges: (i) a combinatorially explosive search space that grows exponentially with library size; (ii) variable-length outputs, as different targets require different numbers of parts; and (iii) continuous 6-DoF pose estimation for part assembly. To address these, we formulate retrieval and assembly as a set prediction problem and design a novel transformer-based framework that retrieves parts and regresses their poses with variable-length output. Additionally, we exploit the duality between part pose estimation and target segmentation through joint training and a novel segmentation-enhanced optimization module. Finally, We curate a large-scale dataset of 80K+ shapes, and the results show that PART generalizes to scene layouts, image targets, and real-world scans. Project Page: https://iambrc.github.io/PART-project-page/.
tldr: PART 统一 Transformer 框架，从部件库检索部件并预测 6-DoF 位姿以重建目标形状。
motivation: 现有方法多在预定义部件集上完成装配，而给定目标形状与部件库的检索式装配更贴近实际却研究不足。该任务面临组合搜索空间随库规模指数增长、输出长度可变以及连续 6-DoF 位姿估计三大挑战。
method: PART 将部件检索与装配建模为集合预测问题，设计基于 Transformer 的统一框架，以可变长度输出检索合适部件并回归其 6-DoF 位姿。方法还利用部件位姿估计与目标分割之间的对偶性，通过联合训练和分割增强优化模块提升装配性能。
result: 作者构建了包含 80K+ 形状的大规模数据集。结果表明 PART 能泛化到场景布局、图像目标和真实世界扫描；摘要未提供其他具体量化指标。
conclusion: PART 为基于检索的 3D 部件装配提供了统一框架，将检索与装配转化为集合预测，并借助位姿-分割对偶性增强优化。其泛化能力显示该方法在场景布局、图像目标与真实扫描等实际应用中具有潜力。

title: SnapPhysics: A Physics-Aware Scene Graph from a Single View for Interactive Mixed Reality Scenes
abstract: We propose SnapPhysics, a training-free framework that reconstructs 3D objects and estimates their physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of gravity from a single image. For physically coherent interactions in mixed reality (MR), such properties are as important as geometry. Prior approaches infer them by analyzing object dynamics in video, which is computationally costly, or by querying vision-language models (VLMs) on single images, which lacks geometric grounding and inter-object relationships. We address these limitations by combining instance-level 3D reconstruction and spatial alignment with a physics-aware scene graph that encodes these relationships and per-object metric geometry as structured context for VLM-based property reasoning. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that SnapPhysics improves scene-level F-Score by 18.6% over the best learning-based method, and on real captured scenes with ground-truth mass, it reduces the mean absolute log difference error (mALDE) by up to 20.5% and improves log-scale correlation ($r^2_{\mathrm{ls}}$) by up to 19.6% over VLM-only estimation. SnapPhysics enables physically interactive MR experiences without manual parameter tuning. Project page: https://snapphysics-ismar2026.github.io/.
tldr: SnapPhysics无需训练，从单张图像重建3D物体并估计质量、摩擦和重心，用于物理交互MR。
motivation: 混合现实中物理一致的交互不仅依赖几何，还需要质量、摩擦和重心等物理属性；现有视频动态推断计算昂贵，而单图VLM查询缺乏几何接地和物体间关系。
method: 提出免训练框架SnapPhysics，将实例级3D重建与空间对齐同物理感知场景图结合，场景图编码物体间关系和每个物体的度量几何，作为结构化上下文供VLM进行物理属性推理。
result: 在3D-FRONT上场景级F-Score比最佳学习方法提升18.6%；在带质量真值的真实拍摄场景中，mALDE较仅VLM估计最多降低20.5%，log尺度相关性r2_ls最多提升19.6%。
conclusion: SnapPhysics实现了无需手动调参的物理可交互MR体验，贡献在于用单视图物理感知场景图增强VLM物理推理，为MR场景理解与交互提供新思路。

title: Printing the Underdetermined: Materializing Multi-solutionness in Figurative Paintings
abstract: Figurative paintings are often approached as if they depict a single recoverable 3D scene: viewers infer depth and occlusion, and reconstruction pipelines attempt to converge to one stable model. We instead foreground multi-solutionness, the non-uniqueness of 3D configurations compatible with a single painted image, and propose a workflow that keeps this non-uniqueness visible and material. Multi-solutionness arises from two sources: unobserved content, where backsides and occluded volumes admit multiple plausible completions, and observed cues, where perspective, shading, and occlusion still underconstrain geometry. When additional views are synthesized by a video generative model without explicit 3D constraints, small frame-level drifts become inevitable rather than exceptional. Our pipeline samples multiple camera-orbit multi-view video sequences from one painting, reconstructs each sequence with 3D Gaussian Splatting into a point-based Gaussian scene representation where density halos and ghosting expose unresolved degrees of freedom, and fabricates these representations as physical artifacts using DreamPrinting. By treating multiple compatible interpretations as explicit outputs rather than residual error, we provide a computational framework for spatial readings of figurative painting that can be inspected, compared, and discussed in both digital and physical form.
tldr: 提出保留绘画3D多解性的流程：多视角视频生成、3DGS重建与DreamPrinting实体化。
motivation: 具象绘画常被当作可唯一恢复的3D场景，重建流程试图收敛到单一稳定模型。本文转而强调多解性，即单幅绘画可对应多种非唯一3D配置，并希望让这种非唯一性保持可见、可物质化。多解性来自未观测内容与观测线索不足两方面。
method: 从单幅绘画出发，用视频生成模型采样多段相机环绕的多视角视频序列，且不施加显式3D约束。随后用3D Gaussian Splatting逐段重建为基于点的Gaussian场景表示，其中密度光晕与重影暴露未解析自由度，并通过DreamPrinting将表示制作为物理实体。
result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果；主要产出是多个兼容3D解释的生成、重建与实体化，密度光晕和重影被用作未解析自由度的可视化证据。
conclusion: 作者将多种兼容解释视为显式输出而非残差误差，为具象绘画的空间解读提供可检查、可比较、可讨论的数字与物理计算框架。

title: GAPrompt++: Multi-Granular Geometry-Aware Point Cloud Prompt for 3D Vision Model
abstract: Pre-trained 3D vision models have substantially advanced point cloud analysis, yet adapting them to downstream tasks via full fine-tuning is computationally expensive and storage-intensive. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) offers a promising alternative by reducing both adaptation cost and storage burden. However, existing prompting-based approaches ignore the intrinsic geometric structures of point clouds, thereby limiting their adaptation capability. This limitation stems from their inability to encode both fine-grained geometric cues and coarse-grained structural semantics, as well as failing to propagate such information effectively through the model hierarchy. To address these challenges, we propose GAPrompt++, a multi-granular geometry-aware prompting method that provides richer geometric guidance for efficient 3D task adaptation. Specifically, we introduce a Point Shift Prompter that extracts multi-granular geometric features across different scales, enabling instance-specific geometric adjustments during adaptation. Next, a Keypoint Prompter adaptively generates point-level prompts to highlight local geometric saliency and fine-grained structural details. Furthermore, a Prompt Propagation mechanism injects these multi-granular geometric cues throughout the feature extraction hierarchy, strengthening the ability to capture essential geometric characteristics. Extensive experiments show that GAPrompt++ achieves state-of-the-art performance among prompting-based PEFT methods and even surpasses full fine-tuning across diverse benchmarks, while requiring less than 2\% trainable parameters. In addition, to address the saturation of existing evaluation datasets, we construct two more challenging benchmarks derived from 3D Gaussian Splatting and Multi-View Stereo reconstruction, offering diverse and realistic point cloud scenarios to promote future research.
tldr: GAPrompt++提出多粒度几何感知点云提示，以不到2%可训练参数超越全量微调并构建新基准。
motivation: 预训练3D视觉模型全量微调计算与存储开销大，而现有PEFT提示方法忽略点云内在几何结构，无法同时编码细粒度几何线索与粗粒度结构语义并在模型层级中有效传播。为此需提升高效3D任务适配中的几何感知能力。
method: 提出GAPrompt++：Point Shift Prompter跨尺度提取多粒度几何特征并进行实例级几何调整；Keypoint Prompter自适应生成点级提示以突出局部几何显著性与细粒度结构；Prompt Propagation将多粒度几何线索注入整个特征提取层级，增强几何特征捕获。
result: 大量实验表明，GAPrompt++在多种基准上取得提示式PEFT方法中的SOTA，甚至超越全量微调，且可训练参数少于2%；同时构建了基于3D Gaussian Splatting与Multi-View Stereo重建的两个更具挑战性的基准。
conclusion: GAPrompt++通过多粒度几何感知提示显著提升3D视觉模型高效适配性能，验证了几何先验注入对PEFT的重要性，并以新基准推动未来点云分析研究。

title: VGGT-GS SLAM: Uncalibrated Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Feed-Forward Priors
abstract: We present VGGT-GS SLAM, a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM system designed for uncalibrated videos. Starting from feed-forward VGGT pose and depth priors, our system performs submap differentiable bundle adjustment that jointly refines camera poses and a 3D Gaussian map, while optimizing submap-shared intrinsics and radial--tangential distortion through analytic calibration Jacobians. To improve global consistency, we introduce Gaussian-native alignment (GNA) for camera-anchored scale refinement between sequential submaps and verification of loop-closure candidates. Extensive experiments on standard indoor benchmarks show consistent improvements in localization accuracy and strong rendering quality under uncalibrated settings, establishing a strong baseline for uncalibrated Gaussian SLAM.
tldr: 提出VGGT-GS SLAM，利用VGGT前馈先验在未标定单目视频上联合优化位姿、高斯地图、内参与畸变。
motivation: 现有单目3D高斯SLAM多依赖已标定相机，未标定视频中内参与畸变未知会削弱位姿估计与地图一致性；本文旨在无需标定即可联合求解位姿、地图、内参和畸变。
method: 以VGGT前馈位姿和深度为初始先验，构建子图可微BA同时优化相机位姿与3D高斯地图，并通过解析标定雅可比更新子图共享内参及径向切向畸变；提出Gaussian-native alignment (GNA)进行跨子图相机锚定尺度细化与回环候选验证。
result: 在标准室内基准上，未标定设置下定位精度相较基线获得一致提升，并保持强渲染质量；摘要未提供具体数值指标。
conclusion: 结果表明VGGT前馈先验结合可微BA、解析标定雅可比与GNA可有效实现未标定单目高斯SLAM，并为该方向建立了强基线。

title: AMB3R-SLAM: Kilometer-scale SLAM with Hierarchical Backend
abstract: We present AMB3R-SLAM, a real-time monocular SLAM system capable of reconstructing kilometer-scale trajectories over 10k frames on a single consumer-grade GPU. Our model couples a lightweight front-end for low-latency online tracking with a hierarchical backend that progressively enforces local, mid-level, and global consistency. By avoiding bundle adjustment that relies on the static world assumption, our system naturally handles complex dynamic scenes out of the box. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our method can be extended to leverage stereo, RGB-D, and LiDAR as additional inputs. AMB3R-SLAM achieves strong camera tracking performance across 9 datasets, reducing the absolute trajectory error (ATE) of previous state-of-the-art methods on VBR and Oxford Spires by over 70%. With additional LiDAR input, our model further reduces ATE to sub-meter level on KITTI and VBR datasets.
tldr: AMB3R-SLAM：单卡实时单目SLAM，分层后端实现公里级轨迹重建，ATE降低超70%。
motivation: 现有单目SLAM多依赖静态世界假设与全局捆绑调整，难以在消费级GPU上实时处理超10k帧的公里级轨迹，且在动态场景中鲁棒性不足。本文旨在不依赖静态假设的前提下，实现实时在线跟踪与公里级全局一致重建。
method: 系统由轻量前端与分层后端组成：前端负责低延迟在线跟踪，后端逐步施加局部、中层与全局一致性约束，从而避免依赖静态世界假设的捆绑调整，天然适应动态场景。该方法还可扩展融合双目、RGB-D与LiDAR等额外输入。
result: 在9个数据集上取得强相机跟踪性能，VBR与Oxford Spires上的绝对轨迹误差（ATE）较此前最优方法降低超过70%；额外引入LiDAR输入后，在KITTI与VBR上进一步将ATE降至亚米级。
conclusion: 结果表明，分层后端可在单张消费级GPU上实现公里级实时的单目SLAM，并天然处理复杂动态场景；多模态扩展能进一步提升精度，为大规模、动态环境下的SLAM提供了新思路。

title: Track, Articulate, Act: Generating Articulation from Casual Human Videos
abstract: Human videos contain rich causal evidence for robot manipulation: they reveal how hand motion induces object motion and produces task-relevant changes in object state. In this work, we study articulated objects such as doors, drawers, cabinets, laptops, ovens, and hinged containers that are ubiquitous in daily life and present unique challenges for embodied interaction. These objects cannot be represented by a single pose; their motion depends on the underlying parts and joints. We introduce a real-to-sim framework that reconstructs a simulation-ready articulated object and hand-object interaction from a casual monocular RGB video, without RGB-D or multi-view input, prior scans, manually specified joints, or robot demonstrations. Our key insight is that dense 3D point tracks provide an embodiment-agnostic articulation cue: points on the fixed link remain approximately stationary, while points on the moving link follow coherent revolute or prismatic motion. Our method segments the links, estimates the joint and its state trajectory, reconstructs an articulated asset, and aligns the recovered 3D hand motion with the object. Central to our approach is a modular recipe that repurposes powerful pretrained models for single-image 3D reconstruction, mesh segmentation, and 3D scene flow, connecting their predictions through explicit geometric reasoning to infer articulation. We use the reconstructed articulated object and the human hand trajectory to replay interactions through contact in MuJoCo. The framework shows how pretrained vision models and explicit motion reasoning can turn casual human videos into articulated object models suitable for downstream embodied interactions. https://track-articulate-act.github.io/
tldr: 提出从单目随手视频重建仿真就绪铰接物体与手物交互的 real-to-sim 框架。
motivation: 门、抽屉、橱柜等铰接物体在日常生活中无处不在，但其运动依赖内部部件和关节，无法用单一物体位姿表示，给具身交互带来独特挑战。研究旨在仅凭普通单目 RGB 人类视频，在无需 RGB-D、多视角、先验扫描、手工关节定义或机器人演示的条件下，获取可用于机器人操作的铰接结构与手物交互证据。
method: 核心洞察是密集 3D 点轨迹提供与具身无关的铰接线索：固定连杆上的点近似静止，运动连杆上的点呈现一致的旋转或平移运动。方法据此分割连杆、估计关节及其状态轨迹、重建铰接资产，并将恢复的 3D 手部运动与物体对齐；同时采用模块化方案复用单图像 3D 重建、网格分割和 3D 场景流等预训练模型，通过显式几何推理连接预测，并在 MuJoCo 中利用重建物体与手部轨迹进行接触重放。
result: 摘要未提供定量指标；实验上在 MuJoCo 中利用重建的铰接物体与手部轨迹进行接触重放，展示了从单目随手 RGB 视频生成仿真就绪铰接物体与手物交互的可行性。
conclusion: 该工作表明预训练视觉模型与显式运动推理可将随手人类视频转化为铰接物体模型，为下游具身交互和机器人操作提供 real-to-sim 资产生成途径。

title: NormLift: From Lifted Features To Semantic Reliability In 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Training-free weighted aggregation is widely used to lift 2D semantic features onto 3D Gaussians for open-vocabulary scene understanding, yet its theoretical role remains insufficiently understood. Existing analyses typically justify this operation from the rendering side, treating Gaussian features as linearly composable Euclidean variables for reconstructing 2D feature maps. However, this view does not match downstream 3D usage, where each Gaussian is often queried independently in a cosine-based embedding space. We revisit feature lifting from the 3D side and formulate per-Gaussian assignment as a cosine alignment problem on the CLIP unit sphere. Under this objective, the L2-normalized semantic back-projected feature emerges as the closed-form solution, providing a complementary interpretation of the standard lifting rule from the perspective of per-Gaussian semantic assignment. The same formulation further yields a norm decomposition into intra-view and inter-view consistency, suggesting that feature magnitude itself can serve as a semantic reliability signal. Calibrated by effective multi-view support, this reliability score guides a mode-voting refinement that preserves CLIP feature validity by avoiding linear averaging. Experiments on open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation show that NormLift is an efficient, training-free framework that achieves strong performance across evaluation protocols.
tldr: NormLift 从余弦对齐视角重释 3D 高斯特征提升，用特征模长作语义可靠性信号实现免训练开放词汇分割。
motivation: 免训练加权聚合被广泛用于把 2D 语义特征提升到 3D 高斯上，但其理论作用尚不清晰。现有分析多从渲染侧出发，把高斯特征当作可线性组合的欧氏变量以重建 2D 特征图，这与下游在余弦嵌入空间中逐高斯独立查询的 3D 用法不符。
method: 从 3D 侧重新审视特征提升，把每个高斯的特征分配形式化为 CLIP 单位球面上的余弦对齐问题，推导出 L2 归一化语义反投影特征是闭式解，从而给出标准提升规则的互补解释。该形式化还给出模长的 intra-view 与 inter-view 一致性分解，说明特征幅值本身可作为语义可靠性信号；经有效多视图支持校准后，该可靠性分数驱动 mode-voting 精炼，通过避免线性平均来保持 CLIP 特征的有效性。
result: 开放词汇 3D 语义分割实验表明，NormLift 是高效、免训练的框架，在多种评测协议下均取得强劲性能（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
conclusion: 该工作为特征提升规则提供了基于逐高斯语义分配的新解释，并把特征模长转化为可校准的语义可靠性度量，进而形成免训练、高效的开放词汇 3D 场景理解方案，对 3D 高斯表示下的语义理解具有潜在影响。

title: Geometry beneath the Waves: Dense Priors for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Underwater 3D reconstruction supports applications ranging from marine ecosystem monitoring and subsea inspection to underwater archaeology, education, and immersive visualisation. 3D Gaussian Splatting has made real-time photorealistic novel-view rendering practical, while underwater variants incorporate physically based image-formation models to separate medium effects from scene radiance. Their reconstruction quality, however, remains fundamentally limited by the geometry used for initialisation.
tldr: 针对稀疏视角水下3DGS因初始化几何不佳导致重建质量受限的问题，提出基于稠密先验的改进方法。
motivation: 水下3D重建可用于海洋生态监测、水下检测、考古、教育与沉浸式可视化；3DGS已实现实时逼真新视角渲染，水下变体通过基于物理的图像形成模型分离介质效应与场景辐射，但重建质量受初始化几何的根本限制。
method: 标题提示采用稠密先验（Dense Priors）服务于稀疏视角水下3DGS的几何初始化，但摘要未给出具体技术路线与网络设计。
result: 摘要未提供相关信息
conclusion: 摘要未提供相关信息

title: CADSplat: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting Aided by CAD Models for Robust, Photorealistic Digital-Twin Reconstruction
abstract: We present CADSplat, a framework that reconstructs photorealistic, geometrically accurate digital twins from sparse ($<15$ views), wide-baseline posed images of an object by regularizing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with an explicit CAD shape prior. Using such a prior requires finding a CAD model whose shape resembles the object depicted in the images and determining the pose of each camera relative to the object. We obtain both by matching segmented object silhouettes against silhouettes rendered from a CAD library and keeping the camera-to-object poses of the best-matching model. We then anchor 3D Gaussian primitives to the surface of the retrieved model and jointly optimize the 3DGS parameters, the camera-to-object registration, and a non-rigid deformation field to account for shape differences between the physical object and the CAD model. Across two real-world datasets, CADSplat outperforms unconstrained, few-shot, and mesh-texturing baselines and degrades gracefully to as few as 3 views. Our experiments show that most of the gain in rendering quality comes from how the splats are constrained---a fixed set of splats tied to a surface and moved by a single smooth deformation field---rather than from the CAD shape itself. The CAD model adds shape knowledge where views are scarcest, in the sparsest captures and on strongly self-occluded objects, and it places every camera in the object's own frame. This enables applications beyond novel-view synthesis, such as markerless augmented reality registration, per-image object pose estimation, physical simulations, and the transfer of part labels from the design to the reconstruction.
tldr: CADSplat 用 CAD 形状先验约束 3D 高斯，从少于 15 个稀疏视角重建逼真数字孪生模型。
motivation: 稀疏视角（少于 15 张）、大基线的物体图像难以支撑传统 3DGS 重建，容易出现过拟合与几何失真，而现有少样本方法缺乏显式形状约束。作者希望借助 CAD 模型这一显式形状先验，同时解决重建质量与相机—物体位姿标定两个问题。
method: 先对图像做物体分割，将轮廓与 CAD 库中模型渲染的轮廓进行匹配，取最佳匹配模型的相机—物体位姿作为初值；随后把 3D 高斯图元锚定在检索到的 CAD 表面上，联合优化高斯参数、相机—物体配准以及一个非刚性形变场，以补偿实物与 CAD 模型之间的形状差异。
result: 在两个真实数据集上，CADSplat 优于无约束、少样本和网格纹理化等基线，并在仅 3 个视角时仍能优雅退化。消融表明渲染质量的大部分提升来自高斯的约束方式（固定在表面、由单一平滑形变场驱动），而非 CAD 形状本身；CAD 先验在视角最少和自遮挡严重的物体上补充形状知识。
conclusion: 该工作证明显式 CAD 先验可有效正则化稀疏视角 3DGS 并同时给出物体坐标系下的相机位姿，其贡献更多在于高斯的表面锚定与平滑形变设计。除新视角合成外，该框架还支持无标记增强现实配准、逐图像物体位姿估计、物理仿真以及将设计中的部件标签迁移到重建结果上。

title: GeoCond: A Conditioning-Aware Reliability Adapter for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward 3D foundation models such as VGGT predict cameras, depth, and point maps in a single pass, but can fail silently under low overlap, low parallax, and extreme relative rotation. Stratified analyses over these factors show that these failures are governed by geometric conditioning and are poorly captured by native aleatoric confidence. We introduce GeoCond, a lightweight reliability adapter for frozen feed-forward 3D backbones. GeoCond reads the backbone's predicted geometry and outputs pose-level uncertainty and a refinement gate. During training, it can be supervised by frame-permutation orbit variance, ground-truth pose error when labels are available, or cycle residuals from unlabelled independent pose graphs. At inference, the default head requires only one backbone pass and a small MLP. On VGGT, GeoCond improves out-of-distribution (OOD) AUSE (area under the sparsification-error curve; lower is better) from $0.32$ to $0.20$ over native confidence, transfers zero-shot to outdoor extreme-view scenes, and avoids the collapse caused by applying bundle adjustment uniformly. Across multiple backbones, cycle-distilled variants provide a ground-truth-free adaptation route, including cases where permutation variance vanishes on equivariant models. The same reliability signal supports gated refinement, pose-graph weighting, calibration, curation, and capture decisions. Reliable feed-forward 3D reconstruction requires not only predicting geometry, but also knowing when that geometry should be trusted.
tldr: GeoCond为冻结前馈3D骨干提供轻量可靠性适配，通过几何条件预测位姿不确定性并提升OOD可靠性。
motivation: 前馈3D基础模型如VGGT能单次预测相机、深度和点图，但在低重叠、低视差和极端相对旋转下会静默失败。分层分析表明这些失败由几何条件主导，而原生偶然不确定性难以捕捉。
method: GeoCond是面向冻结前馈3D骨干的轻量可靠性适配器，读取骨干预测几何并输出位姿级不确定性与细化门控。训练可由帧置换轨道方差、有标签真值位姿误差或无标签独立位姿图循环残差监督；推理默认仅需一次骨干前向和小型MLP。
result: 在VGGT上，GeoCond将OOD AUSE从0.32降至0.20，优于原生置信度，零样本迁移至户外极端视角场景，并避免统一应用BA导致的崩溃。跨多个骨干，循环蒸馏变体提供无真值适配路径，包括等变模型上置换方差消失的情况。
conclusion: 同一可靠性信号支持门控细化、位姿图加权、校准、筛选和采集决策。可靠的前馈3D重建不仅需要预测几何，还需要判断何时应信任该几何。

title: Prosthesis-Aware 3D Human Pose Estimation: A Dataset and Benchmark for RSP Users
abstract: Recovering 3D human body motion from video is important for applications such as rehabilitation assessment and sports performance evaluation. For prosthesis users, this requires capturing both natural body joints and the geometry of the prosthetic device, a challenge that existing methods are not designed to address. Model-based estimators rely on body models trained on non-amputee individuals and cannot represent prosthesis geometry, while model-free methods lack body kinematic priors and are unreliable under occlusion. This challenge is particularly prominent for users of running-specific prostheses (RSPs), where the RSP has a complex curved geometry and moves dynamically during exercise. To fill this gap, we collect RSP3D, the first 3D dataset of RSP users, covering essential daily-life and exercise actions from participants with varied amputation conditions, using a multi-camera marker-based motion capture setup. We formally define the task of prosthesis-aware 3D pose estimation, evaluate representative methods in a zero-shot setting, and confirm their individual limitations. We further propose a hybrid baseline combining model-based body joint estimation with model-free RSP shape recovery, establishing a starting point for future research.
tldr: 提出首个RSP用户3D数据集RSP3D，定义假肢感知3D姿态估计任务并建立混合基线。
motivation: 从视频恢复3D人体运动对康复评估和运动表现分析很重要，但假肢用户需同时捕捉自然关节与假肢几何。现有基于模型方法依赖非截肢者人体模型，无法表示假肢；无模型方法缺乏运动学先验且在遮挡下不可靠，RSP用户因假肢曲率复杂、动态运动而问题突出。
method: 构建RSP3D：首个RSP用户3D数据集，采用多相机标记点运动捕捉，覆盖不同截肢情况的日常生活与运动动作。正式定义假肢感知3D姿态估计任务，在零样本设置下评测代表性方法，并提出结合基于模型身体关节估计与无模型RSP形状恢复的混合基线。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；零样本评测确认代表性方法各自局限，混合基线作为未来研究的起点。
conclusion: 贡献首个RSP用户3D数据集、任务定义与基准，并给出可行混合基线，有望推动假肢用户康复评估与运动分析中的3D姿态估计研究。

title: ParticleSplat: Self-supervised Object-centric Latent Particle Splatting
abstract: We present ParticleSplat, a self-supervised object-centric learning method that decomposes scenes into a set of latent ''particles'' representing semantic entities through feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting. Building on the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework, which represents images as a set of particles with attributes such as position, scale, and visual appearance, we address a key limitation of DLP: its inherently 2D nature, which prevents explicit 3D spatial and geometric reasoning that are critical for downstream tasks such as robotic manipulation. Leveraging the structural similarity between latent particles and 3D Gaussian primitives, we introduce a 3D latent particle space trained with a novel view synthesis objective. Our model jointly encodes multiple views with camera poses into a shared 3D object-centric latent space, then transforms particles into particle-aligned 3D Gaussians whose composition reconstructs the full scene. On simulated and real-world datasets, we show that this formulation inherently learns object masks without supervision and supports controllable 3D scene editing, such as moving objects by modifying particles in the latent space. We further establish that the learned 3D representation improves downstream performance on robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr: ParticleSplat将DLP的2D潜在粒子扩展到3D，用前馈3D高斯泼溅实现自监督物体中心场景分解与编辑。
motivation: Deep Latent Particles (DLP) 以2D粒子表示图像，缺乏显式3D空间与几何推理能力，难以支持机器人操作等下游任务。ParticleSplat旨在将物体中心表示扩展到3D，实现自监督的3D场景分解与几何感知。
method: 利用潜在粒子与3D高斯图元的结构相似性，构建3D潜在粒子空间并以新视角合成目标训练。模型联合编码多视角图像与相机位姿到共享的3D物体中心潜在空间，再将粒子转换为粒子对齐的3D高斯，其组合重建完整场景。
result: 在模拟与真实数据集上，模型无需监督即可学习物体掩码，并支持通过修改潜在空间中的粒子实现可控3D场景编辑（如移动物体）；同时提升机器人操作下游任务性能。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: ParticleSplat首次将DLP框架与3D高斯泼溅结合，实现自监督物体中心3D表示，兼具无监督掩码、可控编辑与下游操作增强能力，为3D场景理解与机器人应用提供了新思路。

title: RGS: Reflection-aware Gaussian Splatting via Learning Geometry Continuity for Reflective Objects
abstract: Gaussian Splatting has significantly improved the quality of novel view synthesis with explicit Gaussian representation. However, we observed that existing 3D Gaussian Splatting methods (3DGS) often suffer from surface collapse issues on reflective regions, and thus produce inferior geometry and low-quality specular. In this work, we propose a physically-based deferred rendering framework, named Reflection-aware Gaussian Splatting (RGS), that can accurately model specular regions and improve novel view synthesis performance. Specifically, we found that a powerful 3D foundation model can provide a strong 3D geometric prior to foster correct geometric modeling. Based on this, we propose a cross-view shape consistency regularization to regularize the geometry surface with the large model prior and cross-view constraints. In this manner, our RGS can produce smoother geometric surfaces on reflective regions while reducing geometric hollows. To further improve rendering results on reflective regions, we present a reflection-aware densification strategy that is designed to capture specular variations across various views. With this strategy, our RGS is able to render novel views of objects in higher quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method consistently renders high-quality reflective objects, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr: 提出反射感知高斯泼溅RGS，利用3D基础模型先验与跨视图一致性正则解决反射区域表面塌陷，实现高质量新视图合成。
motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅方法在反射区域常出现表面塌陷问题，导致几何结构差、镜面反射质量低。该工作旨在准确建模镜面区域并提升反射物体的新视图合成效果。
method: 提出基于物理的延迟渲染框架RGS，利用强大3D基础模型提供几何先验，设计跨视图形状一致性正则化以约束反射区域表面、减少几何空洞；同时引入反射感知致密化策略，捕捉不同视角下的镜面变化。
result: 大量实验表明，RGS能持续渲染高质量的反射物体，并达到最先进性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: RGS通过几何连续性学习与反射感知渲染，有效改善反射区域的几何与镜面质量，推动了反射物体新视图合成的发展。

title: RAUL: Reference-Assisted Ureteroscopy Localization for Skill Assessment
abstract: Objective: Incomplete navigation of anatomy during ureteroscopic kidney stone surgeries can contribute to repeat interventions. While skilled surgeons have lower reintervention rates, there are no objective metrics to quantify scope-navigation performance to evaluate when a trainee becomes skilled. This work aims to recover ureteroscope trajectories from endoscopic video and derive navigation metrics to quantify differences in skill. Methods: We propose RAUL, a reference-assisted reconstruction framework for recovering ureteroscope trajectories from ureteroscope videos only in phantoms. For each phantom, we use a slow, high-quality reference exploration video to generate a reference reconstruction. We localize subsequent exploration videos against this reference. We evaluate localization accuracy against electromagnetically tracked scope pose. We compute navigation metrics from phantom exploration trajectories to compare surgical residents across experience levels. Results: The proposed reference-assisted framework achieves a mean translation root mean square error of $0.5 \pm 0.1$ mm across 9 phantoms. Compared to standard Structure-from-Motion (SfM), the proposed pipeline increases frame-wise localization coverage from $50.5 \pm 14.9\%$ to $86.1 \pm 7.2\%$ of all video frames. The reconstructed trajectories revealed significant differences between high- and low-experience trainees in established navigation metrics. Conclusion: RAUL enables substantially more complete recovery of ureteroscope trajectories from videos compared to standard SfM pipelines, enabling trajectory-based skill assessment without additional tracking equipment. Significance: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first use of video-only recovery of ureteroscope trajectories without external tracking sensors for skill assessment, supporting scalable automated assessment of ureteroscopy navigation skill.
tldr: RAUL利用参考视频辅助重建输尿管镜轨迹，仅凭视频实现高覆盖率定位与技能评估。
motivation: 输尿管镜碎石术中解剖导航不完整会导致重复干预，而目前缺乏客观指标量化镜体导航表现以判断学员是否熟练。
method: 提出RAUL参考辅助重建框架，仅用体模内窥镜视频恢复输尿管镜轨迹；先用慢速高质量参考探查视频生成参考重建，再将后续探查视频定位到该参考，并基于轨迹计算导航指标比较不同经验住院医师。
result: 在9个体的体模上平均平移RMSE为0.5±0.1 mm；相比标准SfM，帧级定位覆盖率从50.5±14.9%提升至86.1±7.2%；重建轨迹在高/低经验学员间显示现有导航指标显著差异。
conclusion: RAUL相比标准SfM能更完整恢复输尿管镜轨迹，无需额外追踪设备即可进行基于轨迹的技能评估；这是首个仅用视频、无外部追踪传感器进行输尿管镜轨迹恢复与技能评估的工作，支持可扩展的自动化导航技能评估。

title: PanoGS-SLAM: Panoramic 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
abstract: Real-time dense SLAM is a core capability for robotics applications that require robust localization and high- quality mapping in dynamic or fast-changing environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based SLAM methods have shown promising performance, but most are designed for narrow-FoV pinhole cameras, where limited angular coverage weakens pose observability and often leads to unstable photo- metric optimization under rapid motion and large viewpoint changes. We present PanoGS-SLAM, the first panoramic dense SLAM system built on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method per- forms differentiable rendering and pose optimization directly in the spherical domain, enabling omnidirectional photometric constraints for more stable tracking. To improve geometric consistency and robustness, we introduce (1) a sphere-consistent photometric loss that compensates for the area distortion of equirectangular projection, and (2) a depth-guided Gaussian initialization strategy that stabilizes incremental mapping in newly observed regions. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic panoramic benchmarks (PALVIO and SynPano) show that PanoGS-SLAM consistently outperforms geometric and GS-based baselines in tracking accuracy and rendering quality, while achieving fast front-end convergence and real-time perfor- mance. In addition, controlled field-of-view experiments reveal a clear monotonic improvement in optimization conditioning and convergence stability as angular coverage increases, high- lighting the fundamental role of sensing geometry in shaping the optimization landscape of differentiable Gaussian-based SLAM. The source code will be made publicly available.
tldr: 首个基于3D高斯泼溅的全景稠密SLAM系统，通过球面域可微渲染与深度引导初始化提升跟踪精度和实时建图质量。
motivation: 现有3DGS-SLAM方法多面向窄视场针孔相机，角覆盖有限导致位姿可观测性弱，在快速运动和大视角变化下光度优化不稳定。该工作旨在构建全景稠密SLAM，利用全向感知提升跟踪鲁棒性与建图质量。
method: PanoGS-SLAM在球面域直接进行可微渲染与位姿优化，获得全向光度约束以稳定跟踪。方法引入球面一致性光度损失来补偿等距柱状投影的面积畸变，并采用深度引导高斯初始化策略稳定新观测区域的增量建图。
result: 在真实与合成全景基准PALVIO和SynPano上，PanoGS-SLAM在跟踪精度和渲染质量上持续优于几何与GS基线，并实现前端快速收敛和实时性能。受控视场实验表明，随着角覆盖增大，优化条件与收敛稳定性呈清晰单调提升。
conclusion: 该工作提出首个基于3DGS的全景稠密SLAM系统，证明全景感知几何能显著改善可微高斯SLAM的优化景观，并为机器人在动态大视角环境中的鲁棒定位与高质量建图提供新方案。源代码将公开。

title: DecoGS: Adaptive Static-Dynamic Decoupling of 3D Gaussians for Free-Viewpoint Video Streaming
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction demands both speed and temporal fidelity, goals that existing methods undermine by updating every Gaussian every frame, even in static regions. We present DecoGS, a method for efficient online training of 3D Gaussians from streaming videos. Unlike prior methods that update the entire scene indiscriminately, DecoGS introduces an adaptive mechanism that selectively focuses optimization on spatiotemporal regions exhibiting motion or photometric changes. This targeted training strategy eliminates redundant updates that cause flickering and drift in nominally static regions, while enabling fast, high-fidelity scene updates. The pipeline further integrates region-aware Gaussian management through gradient gating and efficient visibility filtering to maintain temporal coherence and a compact memory footprint. On N3DV and MeetRoom, DecoGS achieves 34.55 and 31.60 dB PSNR respectively, outperforming all streaming and offline baselines, while rendering at 261 FPS with $70\times$ lower temporal flicker than the best prior method, requiring no large-scale pretraining.
tldr: DecoGS通过自适应静动态解耦与区域感知管理，实现高效低闪烁的自由视点视频流式重建。
motivation: 现有流式3D重建方法每帧更新所有高斯，导致静态区域冗余更新、闪烁和漂移，难以兼顾速度与时间保真。DecoGS旨在仅优化运动或光度变化的时空区域，以解决这一矛盾。
method: 提出自适应机制，选择性优化存在运动或光度变化的时空区域，消除静态区域冗余更新。结合梯度门控的区域感知高斯管理与高效可见性过滤，保持时序一致性和紧凑内存，并支持无需大规模预训练的在线训练。
result: 在N3DV和MeetRoom上PSNR分别达34.55和31.60 dB，超过所有流式与离线基线。渲染速度261 FPS，时间闪烁比最佳先前方法低70倍，且无需大规模预训练。
conclusion: DecoGS证明静动态解耦与区域感知更新可同时提升流式自由视点视频的重建质量、速度和时序稳定性。为在线3D高斯流媒体提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: HuMemSLAM: Efficient Human-Inspired Semantic Place Recognition for Robust Visual SLAM
abstract: Autonomous systems require reliable place recognition for efficient and effective simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM). Traditional geometric visual SLAM approaches rely on low-level features and geometric consistency, but remain vulnerable to perceptual aliasing, where different places appear similar, and perceptual variation, where the same place appears different. Although semantic SLAM and modern learned visual place recognition (VPR) methods improve robustness under challenging perceptual conditions, real-time deployment requires both high retrieval accuracy and low latency. Inspired by human memory and perception, we propose HuMem-VPR, which exploits the bidirectional relationship between bottom-up perceptual evidence and top-down contextual reasoning to achieve high-level place understanding. We further introduce HuMemSLAM, the integration of HuMem-VPR with ORB-SLAM3. HuMem VPR achieved the highest aggregate retrieval accuracy on the real-image benchmark, competitive accuracy on the CARLA benchmark, and approximately two to three times lower latency than the evaluated state-of-the-art VPR methods. Across the evaluated dataset families and online experiments, HuMemSLAM substantially improved integrated Recall @1 over ORB-SLAM3's native retrieval while reducing the proposals submitted to its geometric backend.
tldr: 提出人类记忆启发的HuMem-VPR并集成到ORB-SLAM3，提升语义地点识别精度与实时性。
motivation: 传统几何视觉SLAM依赖低层特征与几何一致性，易受感知混叠和感知变化影响。语义SLAM与学习式视觉地点识别虽提升鲁棒性，但实时部署仍需高检索精度与低延迟。
method: 受人类记忆与感知启发，提出HuMem-VPR，利用自下而上感知证据与自上而下上下文推理的双向关系实现高层地点理解。进一步将其与ORB-SLAM3集成，形成HuMemSLAM。
result: HuMem-VPR在真实图像基准上取得最高综合检索精度，在CARLA基准上具备竞争力，且延迟比评估的SOTA VPR方法低约2至3倍。在多个数据集族和在线实验中，HuMemSLAM相较ORB-SLAM3原生检索显著提升集成Recall@1，同时减少提交给几何后端的候选数量。
conclusion: 结果表明，人类记忆启发的语义地点识别可在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，并增强ORB-SLAM3在挑战性感知条件下的鲁棒性。该方法为实时语义SLAM中的地点识别与后端负载降低提供了有效方案。

title: Bi-FlowGS: Bridging Generative View Completion and Gaussian Geometry through Bidirectional Flow Co-Refinement
abstract: Sparse-view 3D scene reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is inherently underconstrained. Plausible renderings can also coexist with erroneous Gaussian geometry, as errors in positions or depths may be concealed by opacity, scale, and appearance; we term this failure mode Geometry Cheating. Existing regularization methods constrain geometry but remain limited to observed views, while video-diffusion-based methods complete unseen views yet mainly use them as RGB pseudo-supervision, underusing motion and temporal priors and lacking explicit geometry supervision. We present Bi-FlowGS, which uses optical flow to bridge generative view completion and Gaussian geometry regularization. Our plug-and-play Video-to-Geometry Flow Distillation (V2G) distills temporal correspondence priors from restored videos into Gaussian geometry to alleviate Geometry Cheating. Conversely, Geometry-to-Video Flow-Guided Restoration (G2V) uses the current 3DGS geometry to guide temporally consistent video restoration, providing more reliable generative supervision. Together, V2G and G2V form an implicit bidirectional co-refinement process, enabling restored videos and the optimized 3DGS scene to iteratively improve each other. Experiments demonstrate improved rendering quality and geometric consistency across wide-baseline and unbounded 360° benchmarks.
tldr: Bi-FlowGS 用光流桥接生成式视角补全与 3DGS 几何，通过双向流协同精炼缓解稀疏视角下的几何作弊。
motivation: 稀疏视角 3DGS 重建本质欠约束，常出现 Geometry Cheating：错误的位置或深度几何被不透明度、尺度和外观掩盖，导致渲染看似合理但几何错误。现有正则方法仅约束观测视角，而视频扩散方法虽补全未见视角，却主要作为 RGB 伪监督，未充分利用运动/时序先验且缺乏显式几何监督。
method: 提出 Bi-FlowGS，以光流为桥梁连接生成式视角补全与高斯几何正则。其即插即用的 V2G 将恢复视频中的时序对应先验蒸馏到高斯几何以缓解 Geometry Cheating，反向的 G2V 则用当前 3DGS 几何引导时序一致视频恢复，二者构成隐式双向协同精炼，使恢复视频与优化后的 3DGS 场景迭代互促。
result: 实验在宽基线与无界 360° 基准上表明，Bi-FlowGS 提升了渲染质量和几何一致性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: Bi-FlowGS 贡献在于通过双向光流协同精炼，将视频生成先验有效转化为高斯几何监督，缓解稀疏视角下的 Geometry Cheating。该方法有望提升稀疏视角 3DGS 重建的鲁棒性、几何可靠性和新视角合成质量。

title: Evaluating Mesh Reconstruction Methods for Crop Phenotyping
abstract: Phenotyping an agricultural crop is crucial for studying its entire life cycle, as it provides vital insights to improve yield and, ultimately, food production. Doing the same for crops grown on remote sites is a challenge for the specialists who cannot be available on-site. 3D reconstruction techniques offer a promising solution to this problem by enabling crop digitization, allowing specialists to access the resulting 3D crop models from anywhere at any time. In this work, we evaluate recent 3D reconstruction pipelines for crop phenotyping.
