We focus on 7 mesh reconstruction pipelines and measure the fidelity and consistency of their outputs qualitatively and quantitatively. Our results suggest that the meshes produced by the GGGS, PGSR, and 2DGS are preferable to the other pipelines, owing to their quantitative metrics and visually pleasing outputs. The GGGS pipeline is better than the second-best pipeline (2DGS) by about 27\% on the radar chart with 5 dimensions, namely, User ratings, Chamfer distance, LPIPS, PSNR, and SSIM.
tldr: 评估7种网格重建流程用于作物表型，GGGS、PGSR与2DGS较优，GGGS综合领先约27%。
motivation: 远程站点的作物表型分析依赖专家现场观察，但专家难以到场；3D重建可将作物数字化，使专家远程随时访问3D模型，因此需评估现有网格重建流程在作物表型中的保真度与一致性。
method: 本文针对作物表型评估7种网格重建流程，通过定性与定量方式衡量其输出网格的保真度和一致性，定量指标包括用户评分、Chamfer distance、LPIPS、PSNR与SSIM。
result: 结果表明GGGS、PGSR和2DGS生成的网格在定量指标和视觉效果上优于其他流程；其中GGGS在5维雷达图上比次优的2DGS高约27%。
conclusion: 该研究说明GGGS、PGSR和2DGS等流程可用于作物表型三维重建，GGGS综合表现最佳，为远程作物数字化与表型分析提供了可参考的方案选择。

title: HLC-GS: Risk-Map-Guided Height-Layer Consistency Gaussian Splatting for DSM Reconstruction from Optical Satellite Imagery
abstract: A Digital Surface Model (DSM) is a fundamental geospatial data product for representing the elevation of the Earth's surface. Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for DSM reconstruction from multi-view optical satellite imagery due to its explicit scene representation and efficient optimization. However, in 3DGS-based DSM generation, alpha-weighted aggregation of Gaussian altitudes may blend splats from different height layers at the same rendered pixel or DSM sampling location, producing non-physical intermediate elevations and height-layer mixing errors. To address this problem, we propose HLC-GS, a risk-map-guided height-layer consistency Gaussian Splatting method for DSM reconstruction from optical satellite imagery. HLC-GS consists of a risk map module, a dominant-layer reliability correction module, and a secondary-layer suppression module. The risk map localizes high-risk pixels with abnormal height dispersion and unreliable dominant-layer responses, while the latter two modules regularize unreliable dominant-layer responses and suppress weakly supported far secondary-layer responses. Extensive experiments are conducted on the DFC2019 and IARPA2016 datasets. Compared with six state-of-the-art DSM reconstruction methods, HLC-GS achieves better overall accuracy. Compared with the latest and precision-enhanced EOGS, HLC-GS reduces the average MAE from 1.46 m to 1.18 m and the average RMSE from 2.78 m to 2.58 m over the evaluated scenes, while improving PAG$_{2.5}$ from 86.09\% to 88.61\%. Overall, these results demonstrate that explicitly modeling per-pixel height-layer consistency alleviates height-layer mixing and improves the geometric quality of 3DGS-based DSM reconstruction from optical satellite imagery.
tldr: 提出风险图引导的高度层一致性3DGS方法HLC-GS，用于光学卫星影像DSM重建并抑制高度层混合。
motivation: 3DGS用于多视图光学卫星影像DSM重建时，同一渲染像素或DSM采样位置处不同高度层高斯经alpha加权聚合会相互混合，产生非物理中间高程和高度层混合误差。
method: HLC-GS包含风险图模块、主层可靠性校正模块和次层抑制模块；风险图定位高度离散异常且主层响应不可靠的高风险像素，后两模块分别正则化不可靠主层响应并抑制弱支撑的远次层响应。
result: 在DFC2019和IARPA2016数据集上，与六种SOTA DSM重建方法相比HLC-GS整体精度更优；相较精度增强的EOGS，平均MAE由1.46 m降至1.18 m，RMSE由2.78 m降至2.58 m，PAG_2.5由86.09%提升至88.61%。
conclusion: 结果表明，显式建模逐像素高度层一致性可缓解高度层混合，提升光学卫星影像3DGS DSM重建的几何质量。

title: PriorPose: Reference-Guided Joint Deformation and Alignment for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
abstract: Category-level object pose estimation seeks to recover a similarity transform $(R,t,s)$ for unseen instances without instance-specific CAD models. Most competitive methods are correspondence-based: prior-free variants regress canonical (NOCS) coordinates directly from local observations and implicitly memorize the canonical frame in the weights, which ties the parameters to category-typical orientations and hurts generalization under distribution shift; prior-based variants introduce a category prior but typically follow a serial deform-then-align pipeline, where underconstrained canonical completion can corrupt correspondences and induce error cascades in pose. We propose PriorPose, a reference-guided correspondence framework that keeps the category prior explicit and solves canonicalization and alignment jointly in a shared feature space. A reference-guided seeded transformer embeds the partial observation and the category prior as token sets and fuses them via geometry-aware seeds, from which the network jointly predicts a per-point NOCS field for visible points and a canonical deformation of the prior that reconstructs a full canonical instance, while a deep pose head regresses $(R,t,s)$ from the induced correspondences. A two-part shape consistency objective, with canonical-space and camera-space consistency losses, couples correspondence, deformation, and pose, reducing reliance on memorized canonical orientations and avoiding deform-then-align error cascades. Experiments on standard and larger-category benchmarks demonstrate that PriorPose sets new state-of-the-art results on most evaluated metrics, especially under strict pose thresholds, while remaining competitive on relaxed pose and IoU metrics and showing improved robustness under shape variation and domain shift.
tldr: PriorPose提出参考引导的联合变形与对齐框架，通过显式类别先验和共享特征空间提升类别级物体位姿估计的泛化能力。
motivation: 现有对应关系方法中，无先验方法直接回归NOCS坐标并隐式记忆规范帧，导致参数与类别典型朝向绑定，在分布偏移下泛化差；有先验方法采用串行“先变形后对齐”，欠约束的规范补全会污染对应关系并引发位姿误差级联。
method: PriorPose将类别先验显式保留，并用参考引导的种子Transformer把部分观测与类别先验作为token集融合；网络联合预测可见点的逐点NOCS场和先验的规范变形，以重建完整规范实例，再由深度位姿头从诱导对应关系回归(R,t,s)。两项形状一致性目标（规范空间与相机空间一致性损失）耦合对应、变形与位姿。
result: 在标准及更大类别基准上，PriorPose在多数评估指标上取得新的SOTA，尤其在严格位姿阈值下提升明显；在宽松位姿和IoU指标上保持竞争力，并提升形状变化与域偏移下的鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体数值。
conclusion: PriorPose通过参考引导的联合变形与对齐及双空间形状一致性约束，显式利用类别先验并避免串行流水线的误差级联，为类别级物体位姿估计提供了更泛化、更鲁棒的对应关系框架。

title: MAETrack: Unleashing the Potential of Pretrained Geometric Priors for 3D Single Object Tracking
abstract: Large-scale pre-training has transformed representation learning in 2D vision, yet its transferability to 3D single object tracking (SOT) remains insufficiently understood. Directly fine-tuning self-supervised 3D encoders, such as masked autoencoders (MAE), often leads to sub-optimal adaptation because the reconstruction objective is not fully aligned with the spatial-temporal matching requirements of tracking. In this paper, we observe that this difficulty can be interpreted as a layer-wise transfer mismatch: shallow layers tend to preserve transferable geometric cues, while deeper layers become increasingly specialized to the reconstruction pretext task and are less suitable for downstream tracking. Based on this observation, we propose MAETrack, a lightweight adaptation framework for transferring pre-training MAE representations to 3D SOT. MAETrack includes Layer-Selective Initialization (LSI), which initializes only the shallow stages of the tracking backbone from pre-trained weights while re-initializing deeper stages, and Geometric Residual Gating (GRG), which reinforces structurally salient regions in the search BEV features before template-search fusion through residual spatial modulation. Extensive experiments on standard 3D SOT benchmarks show that MAETrack consistently improves upon vanilla fine-tuning baselines with limited computational overhead. More broadly, our results suggest that effective transfer from 3D reconstruction pre-training to 3D tracking is not merely a matter of partial fine-tuning, but depends on a tracking-oriented transfer principle that preserves shallow geometry while adapting deeper representations to the downstream objective.
tldr: 提出MAETrack，通过层选择性初始化与几何残差门控，将MAE预训练表征高效迁移至3D单目标跟踪。
motivation: 3D单目标跟踪中直接微调MAE等自监督3D编码器效果次优，原因是重建目标与跟踪所需的时空匹配不一致；作者进一步发现浅层保留可迁移几何线索，深层过度特化于重建任务，造成逐层迁移失配。
method: 提出轻量适配框架MAETrack：层选择性初始化（LSI）仅用预训练权重初始化跟踪骨干浅层，深层重新初始化；几何残差门控（GRG）在模板-搜索融合前通过残差空间调制增强搜索BEV特征中的结构显著区域。
result: 在标准3D单目标跟踪基准上，MAETrack以有限计算开销持续优于朴素微调基线；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，从3D重建预训练到3D跟踪的有效迁移不仅是部分微调，而需遵循面向跟踪的迁移原则：保留浅层几何并适配深层表征至下游目标。

title: Lesion-centered 3D mapping of colonoscopy procedures: validation of a hierarchical ensemble pipeline on public benchmark videos
abstract: Background and Objective: Colonoscopy recording practice preserves text reports and still photographs, while the spatial information already present in the recorded video - where the scope traveled, where a lesion was observed, and whether the same lesion was seen again - is discarded when the procedure ends. This study determines whether a lesion-centered spatial record can be assembled and validated without full-colon 3D reconstruction. Methods: A four-layer hierarchical pipeline was assembled - (1) a global topological map, (2) lesion-level spatio-temporal tracks, (3) on-demand local 3D reconstruction, and (4) persistent lesion identity across repeated observations - and ran end to end on four public videos (two C3VDv2 sequences with ground-truth depth and two full REAL-Colon procedures; 40,245 frames). All components are published, individually validated methods; the contribution is their lesion-centered assembly, linking rules, and evaluation. Results: Revisits, impossible under forward-only mapping by construction, were detected by entry-map Bayesian localization: 5,614 and 4,043 revisit events (56 and 68 distinct nodes) in the two full procedures. Lesion-identity merging at the adopted threshold 0.5 maintained ground-truth purity 1.0 while auto-merging 20 of 231 candidate pairs. The endoscopy-specific geometry engine outperformed a general-purpose foundation model on all metrics (overall absolute relative error (AbsRel) 0.2276 vs. 0.3523). Conclusions: The results are partial but establish a concrete near-term path: revisit detection, lesion identity, and local 3D each returned quantitative, reproducible output without waiting for complete geometric reconstruction; validating the record on clinical data is the next step.
tldr: 提出以病灶为中心的四层结肠镜空间建图流程，并在公开视频上验证重访检测、病灶身份合并与局部3D重建。
motivation: 结肠镜记录实践通常仅保留文本报告和静态照片，而视频中已有的空间信息——镜身行进路径、病灶观察位置以及同一病灶是否被再次观察到——在检查结束后即被丢弃。本研究旨在不依赖全结肠3D重建的情况下，构建并验证以病灶为中心的空间记录。
method: 构建四层分层流程：全局拓扑图、病灶级时空轨迹、按需局部3D重建、跨重复观察的持久病灶身份，并在四段公开视频（两段C3VDv2序列含深度真值、两段完整REAL-Colon操作，共40245帧）上端到端运行。所用组件均为已发表且单独验证的方法，本文贡献在于以病灶为中心的集成、链接规则与评估。
result: 入口图贝叶斯定位检测到前向建图无法实现的重访：两段完整操作分别有5614和4043次重访事件、56和68个不同节点；阈值0.5下病灶身份合并保持真值纯度1.0，并自动合并231对候选中的20对；内镜专用几何引擎在所有指标上优于通用基础模型，总体AbsRel为0.2276对0.3523。
conclusion: 结果虽部分但确立了近期可行路径：重访检测、病灶身份与局部3D均无需等待完整几何重建即可输出定量、可复现结果；下一步是在临床数据上验证该空间记录。

title: G3AR: Graph-Guided Neural Visual Geometry for Scalable Multi-Sequence Aerial Registration
abstract: Full-context neural visual geometry is impractical for thousands of images, while sequence-based chunking poorly captures irregular non-local overlap in multi-sequence aerial collections. We present Graph-Guided Neural Visual Geometry for Aerial Registration (G3AR), a graph-guided framework for scalable dense neural geometry. Before local inference, G3AR builds a geometrically verified image-proximity graph that guides bounded overlapping chunks and induces a chunk graph whose maximum spanning tree defines alignment topology. Compatible backbones process chunks independently; shared-image predictions then estimate three-dimensional similarity (Sim(3)) transforms that register local cameras and geometry in a common frame. Across four real aerial scenes, G3AR improves pose error and runtime in matched VGGT- and Pi3-backed comparisons, while its DA3 variant achieves the lowest pose error among evaluated neural-geometry methods.
tldr: G3AR 用几何验证图像邻近图引导分块与 Sim(3) 对齐，实现可扩展多序列航拍配准。
motivation: 全上下文神经视觉几何难以处理数千张图像，而按序列分块又无法有效捕捉多序列航拍采集中不规则的非局部重叠。该工作旨在实现可扩展的稠密神经几何航拍配准。
method: G3AR 先构建经过几何验证的图像邻近图，用于引导有界重叠分块，并生成分块图，以最大生成树定义对齐拓扑；兼容骨干网络独立处理各分块，再借共享图像预测估计 Sim(3) 变换，将局部相机与几何统一到公共坐标系。
result: 在四个真实航拍场景中，匹配 VGGT 和 Pi3 骨干的对比显示，G3AR 同时改善位姿误差与运行时间；其 DA3 变体在所评估的神经几何方法中取得最低位姿误差。
conclusion: G3AR 通过图引导分块与 Sim(3) 对齐，为大规模多序列航拍配准提供了可扩展的稠密神经几何框架，并验证了其相对现有神经几何方法的精度与效率优势。

title: CALIPER: Metric-Grounded Model-Free Recognition of Visually Similar Industrial Parts
abstract: Fine-grained recognition of visually similar industrial parts is challenging when classes differ primarily in physical dimensions. Normalizing detected object crops to a fixed input size suppresses absolute scale, while CAD models and large class-specific datasets may be unavailable in evolving industrial inventories. We present CALIPER, a model-free RGB-D framework that couples support-based appearance matching with metric size evidence. Each training class is onboarded from a single turntable RGB-D video and one to two labeled real images; 3D reconstruction provides novel-view appearance support, while aligned depth yields a class-specific metric size profile. At inference, a coarse YOLOv8n-seg model localizes parts, and a frozen DINOv2 backbone with an episodically trained embedding head performs fine-grained support matching. Margin-conditioned metric fusion activates probabilistic size evidence only for appearance-ambiguous decisions. New classes are enrolled from a small RGB-D support set without updating network parameters. We evaluate CALIPER on 18 visually similar industrial parts: 16 classes are used for training, while two screws are reserved for training-free enrollment. CALIPER achieves 88.2% closed-set accuracy with 99.8% localization recall and 85.7% overall accuracy after 10-shot enrollment of the two unseen screws. Metric fusion improves unseen-class accuracy by up to 37.4 percentage points without statistically significant degradation of the original inventory. Robot-arm deployment identifies 17/18 parts without deployment-specific retraining.
tldr: CALIPER 提出无模型 RGB-D 框架，融合外观支持匹配与度量尺寸证据，实现相似工业零件识别与免训练新类注册。
motivation: 工业库存中视觉相似零件常仅由物理尺寸区分，将检测裁剪归一化会丢失绝对尺度，而 CAD 模型和大规模类特定数据集往往不可得。现有方法难以在动态新增类别时快速扩展。
method: CALIPER 为每个类仅用单段转台 RGB-D 视频和 1–2 张标注真实图像注册：3D 重建生成新视角外观支持，对齐深度构建类级度量尺寸轮廓；推理时 YOLOv8n-seg 粗定位，冻结 DINOv2 加情节式训练嵌入头做细粒度支持匹配，并以边缘条件度量融合在出现外观歧义时激活概率尺寸证据。
result: 在 18 类视觉相似工业零件上，16 类训练、2 类螺钉留作免训练注册；闭集准确率 88.2%，定位召回率 99.8%，对两未见过螺钉 10-shot 注册后总体准确率 85.7%。度量融合将未见类准确率最高提升 37.4 个百分点，且未显著降低原库存性能；机械臂部署无需针对部署重训即可识别 17/18 个零件。
conclusion: 该工作表明无需更新网络参数即可通过小规模 RGB-D 支持集注册新类，并利用度量尺寸证据显著改善外观相似零件识别，适用于动态工业库存与机器人操作。

title: Wind on Trees: Testing Physical Grounding in Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Monocular reconstruction of wind-driven vegetation is severely underconstrained: motion along the viewing direction is largely unobservable, a moving canopy offers few reliable correspondences, and nearly the entire scene is dynamic, providing little static reference. Directly-learned deformation fields in 4D Gaussian Splatting therefore optimize photometric consistency rather than recover the motion that produced it. We replace that field with a physically parameterized deformation prior: one damped harmonic oscillator per rigid part, driven by the observed wind and integrated by differentiable RK4, supervised photometrically alone. To test whether such a prior is physically grounded rather than merely well fit, we build a controlled synthetic testbed of three procedurally generated trees spanning an order of magnitude in skeleton complexity, whose per-part natural frequency follows from its own geometry and whose damping ratio is a fixed constant, both held out of training. On it, we measure held-out views, temporal extrapolation, zero-shot transfer to unseen wind speeds, and recovery of the physical parameters themselves. The prior costs appearance fidelity on in-distribution views and extrapolates markedly better outside the training window and the training wind, while parameter recovery is far weaker than it first appears: frequency recovery survives an untrained null control on only the sparsest of the three trees, and damping is not recovered at all.
tldr: 用阻尼谐振子物理先验替代4DGS形变场，提升外推但物理参数恢复有限。
motivation: 单目风驱植被重建严重欠约束：沿视向运动不可观测、动态冠层对应稀缺且几乎全场景动态缺乏静态参考；现有4DGS直接学习形变场倾向于优化光度一致性，而非恢复产生运动的物理机制。
method: 以每个刚性部件一个阻尼谐振子作为物理参数化形变先验，由观测风驱动并用可微RK4积分，仅用光度监督训练；同时构建三棵程序生成树的受控合成测试床，骨架复杂度跨一个数量级，其自然频率由部件几何决定、阻尼比固定，二者在训练中留出。
result: 该先验牺牲分布内视角的外观保真度，但在训练时间窗和训练风速之外外推显著更好；物理参数恢复却远弱于表面表现：频率恢复仅在三种树中最稀疏的一棵上优于未训练零控制，阻尼完全未被恢复。
conclusion: 研究表明物理参数化先验可改善动态4DGS在训练窗口与风速外的外推，但参数恢复结果警示不能仅凭拟合优度声称物理基础；贡献在于提出该先验、受控合成测试床及涵盖外推与参数恢复的评估协议。

title: G3AR: Graph-Guided Neural Visual Geometry for Scalable Multi-Sequence Aerial Registration
abstract: Full-context neural visual geometry is impractical for thousands of images, while sequence-based chunking poorly captures irregular non-local overlap in multi-sequence aerial collections. We present Graph-Guided Neural Visual Geometry for Aerial Registration (G3AR), a graph-guided framework for scalable dense neural geometry. Before local inference, G3AR builds a geometrically verified image-proximity graph that guides bounded overlapping chunks and induces a chunk graph whose maximum spanning tree defines alignment topology. Compatible backbones process chunks independently; shared-image predictions then estimate three-dimensional similarity (Sim(3)) transforms that register local cameras and geometry in a common frame. Across four real aerial scenes, G3AR improves pose error and runtime in matched VGGT- and Pi3-backed comparisons, while its DA3 variant achieves the lowest pose error among evaluated neural-geometry methods.
tldr: G3AR通过图引导分块与Sim(3)对齐，实现可扩展多序列航拍神经几何配准。
motivation: 研究动机：全上下文神经视觉几何在数千张图像上不可扩展，而基于序列的分块难以捕捉多序列航拍采集中不规则的非局部重叠。
method: 方法：G3AR 在局部推理前构建经过几何验证的图像近邻图，用以生成有界重叠分块，并诱导出分块图，以其最大生成树确定对齐拓扑。兼容 backbone 独立处理各分块，再通过共享图像预测估计 Sim(3) 变换，将局部相机与几何配准到统一坐标系。
result: 结果：在四个真实航拍场景中，匹配 VGGT 和 Pi3 backbone 的对比下，G3AR 同时改善位姿误差与运行时间；其 DA3 变体在所评估的神经几何方法中取得最低位姿误差。
conclusion: 结论：G3AR 为大规模多序列航拍配准提供了可扩展的图引导神经几何框架，通过分块独立推理与全局 Sim(3) 对齐兼顾精度与效率，有望推动大范围航拍三维重建应用。

title: The Neverwhere Visual Parkour Benchmark Suite
abstract: State-of-the-art visual locomotion controllers are increasingly capable at handling complex visual environments, making evaluating their real-world performance before deployment increasingly difficult. This work intends to narrow this train/evaluation gap by developing a collection of hyper-photo-realistic, closed-loop evaluation environments - The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite - comprised of over sixty 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of urban indoor and outdoor scenes. Our goal is to encourage large-scale and reproducible robot evaluation by making it easier to create and integrate Gaussian splats-based reconstructions into simulated continuous testing setups. We also underscore the potential pitfalls of relying exclusively on 3D Gaussian-generated data for training, by providing policy checkpoints trained over multiple Neverwhere scenes and their performance when evaluated in novel scenes. Our analysis illustrates the necessity of sourcing diverse data to ensure performance. Code and data are available on the project page: https://ziyc.github.io/neverwhere-bench/.
tldr: 提出Neverwhere基准套件，用60多个3DGS城市场景闭环评估视觉运动控制器。
motivation: 当前先进视觉运动控制器能应对复杂视觉环境，但部署前评估其真实世界性能仍然困难；该工作旨在缩小训练与评估之间的差距，并推动大规模、可复现的机器人评估。
method: 构建Neverwhere Benchmark Suite，包含60多个基于3D Gaussian Splatting重建的城市室内外场景，形成超写实闭环评估环境，并简化将Gaussian splats重建集成到模拟连续测试流程中的方式。同时提供在多个Neverwhere场景上训练的策略检查点，用于在新场景中评估性能。
result: 提供了60多个3DGS重建场景构成的闭环评估基准，并给出多场景训练策略在新场景中的评估结果；摘要未提供具体量化指标，但指出仅依赖3D Gaussian生成数据训练存在性能隐患。
conclusion: 分析表明，为确保策略性能，必须引入多样化数据来源；该基准有助于促进大规模、可复现的机器人评估，代码与数据已在项目页面公开。

title: Racing in Volume with Flow Ensembles
abstract: Streaming 4D reconstruction has been demonstrated only indoors, on dense camera rigs surrounding subjects that move at human pace. Outdoor 4D reconstruction exists but relies either on cameras mounted on the moving vehicle itself, or on limited-coverage arrays observing quasi-static subjects offline. The case that actually matters for spectators is a fast-moving subject, watched from a sparse ring of allocentric cameras, streaming. No method targets this, and no benchmark exists to evaluate one. To this end, we introduce FastFlowGS, a streaming 4D Gaussian Splatting method for reconstructing fast-moving subjects from a small set of fixed external cameras, and Monaco4D, a photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 benchmark for high-speed outdoor reconstruction. FastFlowGS fuses sparse matches, semi-dense tracks, and dense optical flow by lifting each signal to 3D with geometric uncertainty and combining them through a Kalman-style temporal update. Monaco4D provides Formula 1 sequences under varied illumination from trackside, onboard, and drone viewpoints with dense ground truth. On CMU-Panoptic, FastFlowGS exceeds the strongest baseline by 12.6% VMAF at 35% greater efficiency. On Monaco4D, where existing streaming methods degrade severely, it improves dynamic-region PSNR by up to 18.6% with 28.3% lower per-frame optimization time. Dataset and additional details can be found at https://humansensinglab.github.io/monaco4d/.
tldr: 提出FastFlowGS流式4D高斯泼溅与Monaco4D基准，实现稀疏固定相机下高速运动目标重建。
motivation: 现有流式4D重建仅限室内密集相机阵列且目标以人类速度运动；户外4D重建则依赖车载相机或覆盖有限的阵列离线观测准静态目标。对于观众真正关心的场景——稀疏全中心相机环形阵列流式观测高速运动目标——尚无方法和基准。
method: 提出FastFlowGS，一种从少量固定外部相机流式重建高速运动目标的4D高斯泼溅方法；它融合稀疏匹配、半稠密轨迹和稠密光流，将各信号以几何不确定性提升到3D，并通过Kalman式时序更新组合。同时提出Monaco4D，基于Unreal Engine 5的高保真高速户外重建基准，包含不同光照下赛道边、车载和无人机视角的F1序列及稠密真值。
result: 在CMU-Panoptic上，FastFlowGS以35%更高效率超过最强基线12.6% VMAF。在Monaco4D上，现有流式方法严重退化，而FastFlowGS将动态区域PSNR最多提升18.6%，并将逐帧优化时间降低28.3%。
conclusion: FastFlowGS为稀疏固定全中心相机下高速户外流式4D重建提供了有效方案，Monaco4D填补了相应评测基准空白。该工作有望推动体育直播、赛车等高速动态场景的实时4D重建与观众体验应用。

title: SceneBench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Vision-Language Understanding of 3D Scenes
abstract:
Vision-language models excel at 2D image understanding but remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Progress is hindered by limitations in current benchmarks. First, 3D datasets often rely on point clouds that capture geometry but discard rich visual features like texture, text, and materials. Second, annotations treat objects in isolation while ignoring real-world hierarchical organization (scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups). Third, evaluation tasks focus narrowly on basic recognition rather than multi-step spatial reasoning.
  In this context, we introduce SceneBench, a benchmark of 966 photorealistic 3D scenes reconstructed with Gaussian Splatting and densely annotated with hierarchical semantics spanning scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups, and individual objects. These annotations are produced through a human-in-the-loop pipeline combining vision-language models with roughly 1,500 human-hours of iterative refinement and verification, producing over 183K annotated nodes with textual descriptions and 3D bounding boxes. Building on this representation, we define three evaluation tasks: Existence-Based Questions probing object attributes, Spatial Intelligence Questions covering counting, size comparison, distance, and directional relations, and Grounded Question-Reasoning-Answer (QRA) triplets requiring multi-step reasoning across semantic levels. Experiments with state-of-the-art vision-language models show that while models perform well on basic recognition tasks (e.g., up to 85% accuracy for detection), performance drops substantially on hierarchical and compositional reasoning (e.g., down to 60% for counting), revealing limitations not captured by existing benchmarks. SceneBench provides a realistic testbed for developing and evaluating models capable of fine-grained spatial reasoning in photorealistic 3D environments.
tldr: SceneBench 是面向真实感3D场景的层次化视觉语言理解基准，揭示模型在多步空间推理上的不足。
motivation: 现有3D基准多依赖点云，丢失纹理、文字和材质等视觉特征；标注常孤立处理物体，忽略场景、房间、功能区、物体组等层次结构；评测任务也偏基础识别，缺乏多步空间推理。
method: 提出SceneBench，包含966个用Gaussian Splatting重建的真实感3D场景，并以人机回环流程结合视觉语言模型和约1500小时人工迭代精修，构建超183K个带文本描述与3D边界框的层次语义节点。定义存在性问答、空间智能问答（计数、大小比较、距离、方向关系）和需跨语义层级多步推理的Grounded QRA三元组三类任务。
result: 实验显示当前先进视觉语言模型在基础识别上表现较好（如检测最高约85%准确率），但在层次化和组合推理上显著下降（如计数最低约60%），暴露出既有基准未覆盖的局限。
conclusion: SceneBench为在真实感3D环境中开发和评估细粒度空间推理模型提供了现实测试平台，其结果表明层次语义与多步推理仍是视觉语言模型的重要短板。

title: SURE-Map: Self-Correcting Streaming Geometric Foundation Model
abstract: Streaming geometric foundation models are emerging as a compelling alternative to SLAM systems. Yet this streaming nature introduces a fundamental issue: each prediction is made from limited context, which is vulnerable to dynamic objects and weak textures. Small local errors accumulate into severe geometric distortion and long-horizon scale drift. We argue that reliable streaming reconstruction requires geometric foundation models to be not only predictive, but also self-correcting. We introduce SURE-Map, a self-correcting framework built upon two complementary principles. First, we explicitly model cross-view geometric uncertainty. Unlike conventional depth or point confidence, which primarily reflects the reliability of individual-view prediction, our uncertainty directly measures whether the jointly predicted pose and depth induce geometrically consistent cross-view pixel correspondences. Second, because local correction alone cannot eliminate slowly accumulating scale errors, we introduce multi-timescale self-correction: fast consecutive-frame inference preserves streaming efficiency, while sparse keyframe-window inference provides longer-range geometric evidence to periodically recalibrate the scale of recent trajectories. SURE-Map establishes new state-of-the-art performance for online feed-forward reconstruction across long-horizon benchmarks, reducing ATE-RMSE from 24.00 to 17.24 m on KITTI, 5.11 to 4.74 m on Oxford Spires, and 31.37 to 28.58 m on VBR, with further improvements to 15.17, 4.63, and 22.12 m when incorporating loop-closure refinement. Project page: https://mingkai-liu.github.io/projects/sure-map/.
tldr: SURE-Map通过跨视角几何不确定性与多时间尺度自校正，提升流式几何基础模型的长期重建精度并抑制尺度漂移。
motivation: 流式几何基础模型正成为SLAM系统的重要替代方案，但其逐帧预测仅依赖有限上下文，易受动态物体和弱纹理影响。局部小误差会累积为严重几何畸变和长时程尺度漂移，因此可靠流式重建需要模型不仅具备预测能力，还能自我校正。
method: SURE-Map提出两个互补原则：一是显式建模跨视角几何不确定性，直接度量联合预测的位姿与深度是否产生几何一致的跨视角像素对应，而非仅评估单视角预测置信度；二是多时间尺度自校正，快速连续帧推理保持流式效率，稀疏关键帧窗口推理提供更长距离几何证据，周期性重校准近期轨迹尺度，并可结合回环闭合优化。
result: 在长时程在线前馈重建基准上，SURE-Map取得新的SOTA，将ATE-RMSE在KITTI上从24.00降至17.24 m，在Oxford Spires上从5.11降至4.74 m，在VBR上从31.37降至28.58 m；加入回环闭合优化后进一步降至15.17、4.63和22.12 m。
conclusion: SURE-Map证明流式几何基础模型可通过跨视角不确定性建模和多时间尺度自校正显著缓解误差累积与尺度漂移，为长时程在线重建提供了更鲁棒的框架。该工作对SLAM替代方案、几何基础模型及实际机器人/自动驾驶建图具有潜在推动作用。

title: Multi-Stage NeRF for Efficient 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Two Narrow-Angle Angiographic Projections
abstract: X-ray coronary angiography is the clinical gold standard for coronary artery disease during real-time cardiac interventions, but provides only 2D projections of inherently 3D vessels. Existing learning-based 2D-to-3D reconstruction methods typically require wide angular coverage or multiple views, assumptions that are rarely satisfied in routine practice where only two projections with narrow angular separation are available. To address these challenges, we propose NeCA++, a multi-stage self-supervised neural radiance field (NeRF) framework tailored to clinically realistic acquisition constraints. The framework decomposes reconstruction into two stages that progressively refine spatial support and representation capacity. In the first stage, a coarse 3D representation of the vasculature is reconstructed, restricting the subsequent optimisation to regions with a higher likelihood of vessel presence, termed an active region. Afterward reconstruction is restricted to this region while higher-resolution representations are progressively activated to recover fine vascular details. This multi-stage strategy focuses learning on anatomically plausible regions, mitigates gradient dilution under extreme sparsity, and stabilises global topology before recovering fine vascular branches. Furthermore, two vessel-specific regularisations are introduced: a ray-aligned constraint to reduce projection-induced ambiguity, and a bimodal density penalty to enable early vessel-background separation. Extensive experiments across three datasets (ImageCAS, ASOCA, and Synthetic RCA) and four angular configurations demonstrate consistent superiority over state-of-the-art baselines, particularly under clinically realistic narrow-angle settings, while achieving reconstruction within 58 seconds per case.
tldr: 提出多阶段自监督NeRF框架NeCA++，仅用两幅窄角冠脉造影投影高效重建3D冠脉，每例58秒。
motivation: X射线冠脉造影仅提供3D血管的2D投影，而现有学习式2D-to-3D重建方法通常依赖宽角度覆盖或多视角，难以满足临床常规中仅有两幅窄角分离投影的现实条件。该工作旨在解决极端稀疏视角与窄角采集下的冠脉三维重建难题。
method: 提出多阶段自监督NeRF框架NeCA++，将重建分解为两阶段：先重建粗粒度血管结构并确定高概率血管存在的active region，再在该区域内限制优化并逐步激活高分辨率表示以恢复细小血管分支。同时引入两种血管特定正则：ray-aligned约束以缓解投影歧义，以及bimodal density penalty以促进血管与背景早期分离。
result: 在ImageCAS、ASOCA和Synthetic RCA三个数据集及四种角度配置上的大量实验表明，NeCA++一致优于当前最优基线，尤其在临床现实的窄角设置下优势明显，并可在每例58秒内完成重建。
conclusion: NeCA++通过多阶段自监督NeRF和血管特定正则，在仅两幅窄角投影条件下实现了高效且精细的3D冠脉重建，提升了极端稀疏视角下的重建稳定性与拓扑合理性，有望辅助实时心脏介入中的冠脉三维可视化。

title: Closed-form Bayesian homography estimation from noisy point correspondences
abstract: While homographies are fundamental to many computer vision tasks, the majority of conventional estimation techniques provide only point estimates without directly quantifying uncertainty introduced by noisy observations. Uncertainty, though, propagates to subsequent processing steps such as camera calibration and 3D reconstruction and is particularly relevant in safety-critical and socially relevant fields including medical imaging, autonomous driving, and defense. We present a fast Bayesian formulation for homography estimation from point correspondences that explicitly incorporates measurement uncertainty and prior knowledge while providing a posterior distribution over the homography parameters. A closed-form solution of the posterior mean of the homography is derived in homogeneous coordinates and supplemented by an iterative Bayesian approach to handle non-linearities. Synthetic experiments demonstrate the applicability to projective transformations and show improved estimation accuracy over DLT under varying noise conditions. Image stitching experiments further demonstrate applicability to real image correspondences while additionally providing uncertainty information.
tldr: 提出闭式贝叶斯单应性估计方法，在噪声点对应下量化不确定性并优于DLT。
motivation: 传统单应性估计多提供点估计，未直接量化噪声观测带来的不确定性；该不确定性会传播至相机标定、三维重建等后续步骤，在医疗影像、自动驾驶和国防等安全关键领域尤为重要。
method: 提出一种快速贝叶斯单应性估计框架，显式融合测量不确定性与先验知识，并给出单应性参数的后验分布；在齐次坐标下推导后验均值的闭式解，并辅以迭代贝叶斯方法处理非线性。
result: 合成实验证明该方法适用于投影变换，并在不同噪声条件下估计精度优于DLT；图像拼接实验进一步验证其适用于真实图像对应，同时能提供不确定性信息。
conclusion: 该工作为噪声点对应下的单应性估计提供了快速贝叶斯闭式解与迭代扩展，兼顾估计精度和不确定性量化，有望提升相机标定、三维重建及安全关键应用中的可靠性。

title: LG-VLN: A Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation Framework with LangGraph State Orchestration
abstract: Continuous-environment vision-and-language navigation (VLN-CE) requires interpreting natural-language instructions in unseen 3D environments and executing continuous low-level actions. Existing methods often depend on LiDAR, panoramic cameras, or extra sensors; separate geometric-mapping and semantic-navigation visual representations can cause long-trajectory spatial-semantic inconsistencies. We propose LG-VLN, a monocular zero-shot framework with shared visual features and LangGraph-based state orchestration. An online feed-forward 3D reconstruction network predicts depth, camera poses, and dense point clouds for agent-pose estimation and global map fusion. Geometry and navigation share dense CleanDIFT features: semantic consistency rejects incorrect inter-frame correspondences, while target-instance constraints define visual references whose similarity combines with local BLIP-2 image-text relevance to form a semantic value map. LangGraph represents instruction parsing, geometric perception, semantic value updates, path planning, action execution, and failure recovery as a directed state graph with conditional transitions, persistent state, and modular recovery mechanisms. On a fixed 550-episode subset of the R2R-CE val-unseen split, LG-VLN achieves 21.3% success and 12.1% success weighted by path length. Ablations show shared semantic features improve navigation, further boosted by combining visual similarity and image-text relevance. Results establish shared visual representations and explicit state orchestration as effective for zero-shot VLN-CE using monocular RGB alone. Code will be publicly released for reproducibility.
tldr: 提出单目零样本VLN框架LG-VLN，用共享视觉特征与LangGraph状态编排实现连续环境导航。
motivation: 现有VLN-CE方法常依赖LiDAR、全景相机或额外传感器，且几何建图与语义导航使用分离的视觉表示，易导致长轨迹空间-语义不一致。本文旨在仅用单目RGB实现零样本连续环境导航。
method: LG-VLN使用在线前馈3D重建网络预测深度、相机位姿与稠密点云，以估计智能体位姿并融合全局地图；几何与导航共享CleanDIFT稠密特征，通过语义一致性剔除错误帧间对应，并以目标实例约束构建视觉参考，其相似度与BLIP-2图文相关性结合形成语义值图。LangGraph将指令解析、几何感知、语义值更新、路径规划、动作执行和失败恢复组织为带条件转移、持久状态与模块化恢复机制的有向状态图。
result: 在R2R-CE val-unseen的固定550回合子集上，LG-VLN达到21.3%成功率和12.1% SPL。消融实验表明共享语义特征可提升导航性能，结合视觉相似度与图文相关性后性能进一步提升。
conclusion: 结果证明仅使用单目RGB时，共享视觉表示与显式状态编排能有效支持零样本VLN-CE。代码将公开以促进可复现研究。

title: G-ray: Ray-Level Relative Geometric Position Encoding in Multi-View Vision Transformers under Camera Heterogeneity
abstract: We study relative position encoding for multi-view vision Transformers under camera heterogeneity, including varying fields of view (FoVs) or projection models. Existing rotary relative position encodings commonly use image-plane positional coordinates, producing projection-dependent relative phases and inconsistent geometric cues for cross-projection attention. We introduce G-ray, a ray-level relative position encoding whose rotary phases are parameterized by camera-local ray angles. The same camera-local ray pair induces the same relative phase across projections, providing projection-invariant positional consistency. G-ray can be used directly or integrated with existing encodings, retaining complementary geometric cues without additional learned parameters. We validate G-ray in three host encodings, RoPE, GTA, and RayRoPE, across 3D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis (NVS). Across three heterogeneous 3D reconstruction benchmarks at 50 views, G-ray leads all six averaged metrics and reduces mean pointmap relative error by 45.8% over MapAnything, with calibration supplied to both. Trained exclusively on homogeneous pinhole images, the 3D reconstruction model handles mixed pinhole and non-pinhole inputs without retraining and remains competitive on homogeneous pinhole 3D reconstruction protocols. For NVS, GTA and RayRoPE improve with G-ray under joint viewpoint and FoV variation. The project's webpage is available at https://g-ray-project.github.io/.
tldr: G-ray用相机局部射线角度参数化旋转相位，实现跨投影一致的射线级相对位置编码，提升异构相机多视图任务。
motivation: 研究相机异构（如不同视场或投影模型）下多视图视觉Transformer的相对位置编码问题。现有旋转相对位置编码多使用图像平面坐标，导致跨投影注意力中的相对相位依赖投影、几何线索不一致。
method: 提出G-ray，以相机局部射线角度参数化旋转相位，使同一相机局部射线对在不同投影下产生相同相对相位，从而提供投影不变的位置一致性。G-ray可直接使用，也可与RoPE、GTA、RayRoPE等现有编码集成，保留互补几何线索且不增加可学习参数。
result: 在三个异构3D重建基准、50视角设置下，G-ray在六个平均指标上均领先，并将平均pointmap相对误差较MapAnything降低45.8%（双方均提供标定）。仅在均匀针孔图像上训练的3D重建模型无需重训即可处理混合针孔与非针孔输入，并在均匀针孔协议上保持竞争力；在NVS中，GTA与RayRoPE在视角和FoV联合变化下因G-ray获得提升。
conclusion: G-ray通过射线级相对位置编码解决了相机异构下的投影相关相位不一致问题，提升了跨投影注意力的几何一致性。其可即插即用并兼容现有编码，在异构相机3D重建和新视角合成中具有应用潜力。

title: What Makes a 3D Scene Editable? A Factorized Benchmark of Fidelity, Locality, Consistency, and Preservation
abstract: Neural 3D scene editing is often evaluated by semantic alignment alone, although a convincing result may alter unrelated content or become inconsistent across views. We introduce EditBench3D, a representation-agnostic benchmark that treats editing as controlled information replacement. It evaluates four complementary properties: instruction fidelity, spatial locality, cross-view consistency, and preservation of non-target content. The protocol combines visibility-aware 3D target supports, paired descriptions, held-out cameras, and five edit families covering appearance, material, geometry, and object-level changes. We evaluate eight representative NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, hybrid, and proxy-based editors on 240 scene-edit pairs. The study shows that semantic fidelity is only weakly associated with the other editing properties, and that no single method is optimal across all dimensions. Explicit Gaussian editors offer a strong overall balance, whereas direct proxy manipulation provides the most conservative edits at the cost of open-ended fidelity. These findings support reporting editability as a multi-objective profile rather than a single semantic score.
tldr: 提出EditBench3D，从保真度、局部性、一致性与非目标保持四方面多目标评测3D场景编辑。
motivation: 现有神经3D场景编辑多仅用语义对齐评价，可能忽略无关内容被改动或跨视图不一致的问题。该工作希望将编辑评测转向表示无关、可控信息替换的多维基准。
method: 构建EditBench3D，将编辑视为受控信息替换，结合可见性感知3D目标支撑、配对描述、留出相机及五类编辑家族（外观、材质、几何、物体级）。在240个场景-编辑对上评测八种代表性NeRF、3D Gaussian Splatting、混合与代理式编辑器。
result: 实验表明语义保真度与其他编辑属性仅弱相关，且没有单一方法在所有维度上最优。显式高斯编辑器总体平衡较强，直接代理操纵编辑最保守但开放式保真度受限。
conclusion: 该研究贡献了多维可编辑性评测框架，并主张将3D场景编辑能力报告为多目标剖面而非单一语义分数，为后续编辑方法比较提供更全面依据。
